With less than a month until Election Day, it's easy to get caught up in the frenzy of campaigns, debates, and headlines. But we have to remember.. | | | | | [](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=8fca75a91b&e=8cac9e7f7d)
---
| With less than a month until Election Day, it’s easy to get caught up in the frenzy of campaigns, debates, and headlines. But as we push through these final days, we want to pause and remind ourselves _why_ we’re doing this — why Karen Baker decided to run, and why so many of you have joined this movement for change in the 9th District.
[**We’re doing this because people in our community deserve better.**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=ea49aaf9fe&e=8cac9e7f7d) For too long, families have had to travel hours just to see a doctor. Morgan Griffith has been in office for over a decade, but our healthcare system remains broken. Karen is fighting to bring healthcare closer to home, so that no one has to choose between their health and their livelihood.
[**We’re doing this because our veterans deserve a voice.**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=c037b801e0&e=8cac9e7f7d)**
**Karen knows what it means to be the wife of a veteran and the mother of a Marine Sergeant. She’s seen firsthand how our country sometimes fails those who’ve served. When Morgan Griffith voted against the PACT Act — denying crucial healthcare to veterans exposed to toxic chemicals — he showed where his priorities lie. Karen is running to make sure no veteran is ever left behind again.
[**We’re doing this because workers in Southwest Virginia deserve respect.**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=bf87e8bdcd&e=8cac9e7f7d)
Our district was built by coal miners and working families, but too many have been forgotten by Washington. Karen Baker stands with workers, advocating for stronger unions, better wages, and good jobs that can support a family. We believe in a future where no one has to leave home to find opportunity.
**This campaign is about more than politics.** It’s about real people and the issues that affect our neighbors every day. We’re doing this for them, for you, and for every person who deserves to be heard.
But we can’t do it alone. In these final days, we need your help to reach as many voters as possible. Every dollar you contribute goes directly into powering this campaign and ensuring we’re ready to fight until the very last vote is cast.
[**Will you donate $25, $50, or whatever you can today to keep this movement going?**](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=e08dbbfc44&e=8cac9e7f7d)

name: Jason Lindsay, Pride Fund to End Gun Violence
subject: Meet Some of Pride Fund's Endorsed Candidates
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Pride Fund to End Gun Violence PAC
body:
Hi Peter,

One of the most critical elections of our lifetime is in 26 days. We all must fight to save our Democracy from the threat of Donald Trump and his like minded MAGA extremists in Congress and Governors Races. I wanted to take a few minutes to introduce you to some of the candidates that Pride Fund Has endorsed this election season. With your support, we can help these candidates win. Meet three of our candidates below, but before that, I need to ask you to contribute to our crucial campaign efforts. The money we raise during this time will determine the scope of how much we can help our candidates and with Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts.
Will you chip in to our grassroots campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf2024endorse?refcode=2024&amount=25&recurring=yes]

I’m excited to introduce you to three candidates we’ve endorsed who not only stand for sensible gun reform policies but also for LGBTQ equality. But this is just the beginning of many candidates across the nation that we all must help.

Elissa Slotkin for U.S. Senate to represent Michigan: Elissa is the first Member of Congress to have two school shootings in her district – the first in Oxford and the second at Michigan State University in East Lansing. Elissa has seen firsthand the toll gun violence has taken on Michigan and our children. In Congress, Elissa has supported no-brainer gun safety measures to keep our communities safe, including safe storage of firearms, universal background checks, red flag laws, and the assault weapons ban.

Angela Alsobrooks for the United States Senate to represent Maryland : This is a critical seat to win in November and she is a gun safety champion. As a mother, Angela has been deeply affected by the tragic loss of too many children to gun violence and is frustrated by the lack of action from Washington. She is committed to fighting for essential gun safety legislation to protect children and communities from school shootings, mass shootings, and other gun violence. Angela's proposed measures include implementing universal background checks, closing the gun show loophole, banning military-style weapons like AR-15s, and prohibiting devices like bump stocks. Additionally, she supports the implementation of red flag laws to prevent dangerous individuals from acquiring firearms.

Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for the United States Senate to represent Florida: Debbie is standing up to the NRA, taking action, and making progress toward a safer America. We proudly endorse her in her US Senate Race in Florida against Republican Rick Scott. Debbie has such an amazing opportunity to turn the tide in one of the closest races in the country while fighting for the safety of Americans. After losing her father to gun violence, Debbie has been a fierce advocate for common sense gun regulations in this country. She personally knows how devastating gun violence is and will be an essential voice in the Senate in the fight for common sense gun reform.

Peter, thanks to your contributions, we are able to support candidates like these who will not only promote LGBTQ safety and equality, but will also stand up to the gun lobby by prioritizing sensible gun reform legislation over the NRA and their blood money. But we can’t stop now. With your help, we can continue the critical work we do in the fight to end gun violence. clean_body: Hi Peter, One of the most critical elections of our lifetime is in 26 days. We all must fight to save our Democracy from the threat of Donald Trump and his like minded MAGA extremists in Congress and Governors Races. I wanted to take a few minutes to introduce you to some of the candidates that Pride Fund Has endorsed this election season. With your support, we can help these candidates win. Meet three of our candidates below, but before that, I need to ask you to contribute to our crucial campaign efforts. The money we raise during this time will determine the scope of how much we can help our candidates and with Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. Will you chip in to our grassroots campaign today? [] I’m excited to introduce you to three candidates we’ve endorsed who not only stand for sensible gun reform policies but also for LGBTQ equality. But this is just the beginning of many candidates across the nation that we all must help. Elissa Slotkin for U.S. Senate to represent Michigan: Elissa is the first Member of Congress to have two school shootings in her district – the first in Oxford and the second at Michigan State University in East Lansing. Elissa has seen firsthand the toll gun violence has taken on Michigan and our children. In Congress, Elissa has supported no-brainer gun safety measures to keep our communities safe, including safe storage of firearms, universal background checks, red flag laws, and the assault weapons ban. Angela Alsobrooks for the United States Senate to represent Maryland : This is a critical seat to win in November and she is a gun safety champion. As a mother, Angela has been deeply affected by the tragic loss of too many children to gun violence and is frustrated by the lack of action from Washington. She is committed to fighting for essential gun safety legislation to protect children and communities from school shootings, mass shootings, and other gun violence. Angela's proposed measures include implementing universal background checks, closing the gun show loophole, banning military-style weapons like AR-15s, and prohibiting devices like bump stocks. Additionally, she supports the implementation of red flag laws to prevent dangerous individuals from acquiring firearms. Debbie Mucarsel-Powell for the United States Senate to represent Florida: Debbie is standing up to the NRA, taking action, and making progress toward a safer America. We proudly endorse her in her US Senate Race in Florida against Republican Rick Scott. Debbie has such an amazing opportunity to turn the tide in one of the closest races in the country while fighting for the safety of Americans. After losing her father to gun violence, Debbie has been a fierce advocate for common sense gun regulations in this country. She personally knows how devastating gun violence is and will be an essential voice in the Senate in the fight for common sense gun reform. Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. clean_body: The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. Hello, The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father. For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after Roe – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of Dobbs. Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions. But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado. If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support freedom and liberty – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades. I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister. I am incredibly proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose. We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I knew this campaign was going to get nasty, but I never expected the other side to go after my family. body:

Friends, I’d like to share my thoughts on how to stop Donald Trump and his extreme politics.
When America elected Trump, the reins of leadership were put in the hands of a person whose character is so far beneath the office that no rational adult would ever encourage young people to emulate his behavior.
Throughout his administration and through his horrendous attempt to interrupt the peaceful transfer of power, Donald Trump proved that he is unfit to lead.
We have received nine years of clear warnings about a man who wants to seize leadership and use the presidency for his own personal enrichment.
And if he is elected to a second term, we should be under no illusions that he will get any better. In fact, I believe it’s safe to say that the dangerous path he has put us on toward authoritarianism would be even worse.
But I don’t believe any of this is inevitable.
Not only do we have the power to defeat Trump and elect Kamala Harris in just 27 days, but we also have the opportunity to demonstrate once and for all — by delivering a strong condemnation at the ballot box — that there is no place for any politics anymore that embraces Trump’s xenophobic, racist, misogynistic, anti-science, undemocratic tendencies.
Of course, this won’t just happen on its own. We must, and we will work hard every single day between now and November 5th to ensure that every voter knows the stakes, knows their role in protecting democracy, and knows how to get it done.
Will you pitch in whatever amount is meaningful to you to my campaign so we can implement our statewide GOTV program and turn out record numbers of Democrats? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Thank you so much for whatever you can chip in. And if you can’t donate right now, I understand — I hope you’ll still be sure to talk to your friends and neighbors about this election and of course, go vote.
-Tim Kaine

Luna is a far-right extremist who voted to shut down the government right before Hurricane Helene hit, delaying critical FEMA aid when we needed it most. We cannot let someone like her continue representing Florida, especially when it’s clear she doesn’t have our best interests at heart. This is our chance to flip this seat and bring better leadership to our state. If we want to defend reproductive freedom, fight for lower costs, and tackle the climate crisis that’s fueling these hurricanes, we need to act now. My district is one of the Democrats’ best opportunities to win back the majority in the House, but Luna and her wealthy allies are pouring money into this race to keep their grip on power. I’m asking for your help to ensure we have the resources to reach voters and expose Luna’s dangerous record. Will you support my campaign by making a donation today? Every bit helps us get one step closer to flipping this seat and making real change for Florida. Thank you for standing with me. -Whitney Fox

name: Sarah McBride
subject: 📸 Snaps from the campaign trail
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Your support fuels our journey — here's where it's taken us lately!
#
**What an incredible journey we’ve been on together.**
With our general election campaign in full swing, I've been zipping up and down Delaware and wanted to take a quick break from the road to share some of my favorite moments from the past few weeks with you.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**First up, one month ago today we won our primary election!** I'm honored to be your nominee for Congress. This victory isn't just mine – it's ours. This was a monumental celebration of the unwavering support that I’ve seen from this great state. Thank you so much for your support!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**Next, our Democratic ticket hit the road**! We barnstormed Wilmington, Hockessin, and Dover, rallying support for Delaware Democrats up and down the ballot. The energy was electric, and it was fantastic to connect with so many passionate supporters!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**Then came Red October at Delaware State University!** I had an absolute blast cheering on the Hornets at their homecoming. The DSU spirit was contagious, and we’re carrying that energy right into our campaign. Go Hornets!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**I also had the pleasure of celebrating Black Restaurant Week in Wilmington.** Joining the Delaware Black Chamber of Commerce to support our incredible Black-owned businesses was a highlight.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**Last weekend, we kicked into high gear with our Sussex County Day of Action.** With less than 4 weeks until Election Day, the enthusiasm and dedication of our volunteers were truly inspiring.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
And here's a fun update:**I've started a mission to make myself a cup of coffee in every Wawa in Delaware!** Six down so far – who knows how many to go? It's become a running joke in our campaign office, but hey, a caffeinated candidate is an effective candidate, right? 😉
**I am incredibly grateful for the support and love this campaign has received.** What we’re building out here is truly special, and I am proud that this campaign is rooted in compassion, joy, and community. The truth is – YOU made this possible. Your contributions helped keep me on the road, connecting with these amazing people across Delaware.
[**So, can you pitch in $2 — about the cost of a small coffee at WaWa — to keep me on the campaign trail in these final weeks?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?refcode=em20241010-1-1365&amount=2&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)
**[Donate $2 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241010-1?amount=2&refcode=em20241010-1-1365&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)**
Thank you for being part of this journey.
With gratitude,
Sarah McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20241010-1&t=1&refcode2=1365_21716_EU6gAZ&akid=1365%2E21716%2EEU6gAZ)**

name: Common Sense Club
subject: Murphy is making NJ less safe
body:
Peter, New Jersey was one of the safest places in the nation to live. That’s why the recent uptick in crime is so disturbing.
|
---
| Peter, New Jersey was one of the safest places in the nation to live. That’s why the recent uptick in crime is so disturbing. Just last week the Chief of Police in Florham Park [released a public service announcement](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/a8231983d95419f55d31d220e3eb06b1/eJyNkE1PwzAMhv9Lzs3COhCjt2mapqpjBwRnFFJXjZY6UeyujKn_nexDEweQOFp-_Nivj4IBNXJZi0J88leez0QmIhgbLCAvPbI2527-cD-dTTPhLO7W0fdBFMdfh2_AeWr-OM8EHwIk5PVlsazK7fp9U26rRAYd047_eZ7u8ptn9bwoN2Ic_xRDZ3m1T24SBcceTolqm1LxW3SJb5kDFUoNwzBhHSyynyCwYj8gKdDEstXo9xAlOU2tbJyPre5kuninKHmsT2DwzhqQGmvZJLvSka1xQOonLk1roZG-kVfcEvVAMvQfqZQEcX-RoO_RQHf6SCZ0CID19f0VHC45xm-vT5RV) asking residents to be aware and stay safe. The area has experienced a series of burglaries and an attempted burglary that involved perpetrators trying to get into a woman’s locked car [while she was inside](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/637013879c706facd86836433974fc21/eJyNkMFOwzAMht8l54ZsHUijt2mapqpjBwRnZFJDw9IkctyOMPXdCQPtBBJnf__n3z4JRgeO61ZU4p0_ynIhCkGoTTDoeO0dgz5Py5vr-WJeCGvcYUt-CKI6_Rq-AOfUcjkrBKeAGXm4X62ber992tX7JpMBKO_4n-d2Vl48m7tVvRPT9KcYe8ObMbujqJgG_LqoNfkqfiSb-Y45xEqpAKy7K-175fAo35AiJoUQuQPnRyT5Yj110OeiB3WEEeXzQK8WyGCUhMETYyt7T2Si1H5wnGTw1miUEVIuAiGga3--2GD6rjN9AgsLfuw=)! And Florham Park isn’t the only place experiencing an increase in crime. Car theft in Monmouth County [has gone up 300 percent](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/5a195a9a4f85d4974ca0b21ced3a2ea2/eJyNkE9PwkAQxb_LnDtUiiTYGyGENAUORs9m2U5lpfsnu9OWSvrdXdHoRRKvM7_35r25AJMRhosKcjjze5bNIAFPUjlFhlfWsJDXbTa_n86mCTTKnDbetg7yy5_iH-CqWiyyBHhwFJGnx-WqLPabl22xLyPphI83_ufzcPfrs94tiy2M401j0orXXfQOkLNv6bNRpWIrfvZN5I_MLuRp2vf9pLZnQ32YSKvTNqTmDbUYrMfQUkDbGwwsmNB25PEgVIOeaus1HhqhI1HHkTKv6Gyj5BC1IaiOMDh1IpTCIx-pjjkSEM6Rqb4_WtLwFW38AOOUgqo=) since 2017! That’s staggering. Not to mention [an increase in crime](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/a85e51ad7b8191267a879d4f421d02c5/eJyNkMGKwlAMRf8l69baqqDdiYiUqgsZ11LaQJ-2eSEvFav0332jg6sZmHXOPZebByhSQZpVkMJN70kygQAES8MGSVeWtChf12Q2jSdxAI2hy0Zsx5A-fg1_gFdqPp8GoD2jR74Oy1We7TenbbbPPcmF-I7_eRbj5ONZ75bZFobhTzG2RtdX73aQqnT4vagyfpUepfF8rcoujSI6x-N4NiptG7WdcN2Hgo4tOQzPKA770NVWMLwa2yCVGHl3wYxU_Twmx_7dMDwB6cNsVg==)–including a stabbing–has been scaring tourists away from the Jersey shore this summer. What’s to blame? Look no further than Phil Murphy’s soft-on-crime policies. From so-called bail reform to his latest bid [to allow former felons to serve on juries](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/d8bded811e65d0f4e8eca92db8e1fa55/eJyNkMFugzAQRP_FZxw7JpSUWxRFESLNoWrPFYKtMAXbWi-hNOLf6yRVTq3Uy15m9u3MnhmBKQ3lNcvYJ30pFbOIIVTaaTC0tYbK6qqqZLWMlxHrtPnYox0cy86_Lt8N1631-iFiNDkIlpfnzbbIj_u3Q34sgtOVGG78j_Mo1Z2ze9rkBzbPf4Kh17Q7BbZnGeEAl0a1Dq3oFbvgb4icz4QYx3FhLFLTAnqYFpXthSeLkzAw-svgN0UoqVZCJkIuhWt0x_sBXTPxd4s9YDdxbaoSK8CSoOYOrOuAe8ATcNPydkANXqRxEstEpVKmIoQsnQNT_3y4gOkWdf4GkWCFRA==)! Murphy presents his policies as “equity” initiatives. But we know the truth. Meanwhile, Murphy continues to undermine the police officers trying to keep our state safe. He [actually blamed the police force](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/2fa7bf19d584232638515afe0db025cb/eJyNkM1OwzAQhN_F57hO3YJCblVVVVFKDwjOyCRbsjT-kb3FhCrvjgmoJypxXO3MtzN7ZgRGGapaVrIP-pRywTLmoUGHYGhtDalm2sqb5Xwxz1iP5rj19uRYef7TfBFMrqIoMkaDgyR5fFit62q_fd5V-zopnfLpxv84d7m8cDb3q2rHxvEqGDTS5j2xAyvJn-C7UYupFT35Puk7IhdKIWKMs9DZlAJiMEDR-uOssVrIXC5FfityKfTJu27gqtVoMJBXhNbwl15pCLyxLvCD9fwNfICBTzDedMoGHrFvo7VtGhEOPCRH4OqVawxokkdPJJHiKufAtL-_rmH4CT1-AUBdi5o=) for the uptick in crime at the shore. And all of this is just at a state level. Unfortunately, New Jersey is also reaping the effects of our national border crisis. This past spring, ICE agents arrested [40 illegal immigrants with a criminal history in New Jersey](https://xtz223.keap-link005.com/v2/click/e50aa6f1236e457cf91b872de26c03f6/eJyNkU9PwzAMxb9LzjMdHUhbb9M0TdXGDgjOKKSmM23-yHE3yrTvTlrQTiBxc5Kf3_NzzkrQaSdlpQr1IZ95PlMTxWgoEDpZeSfajK_5_d3t7HaiWnLNhn0XVHH-tfkKjF3zxXSipA-YkKfH5Wpb7jcvu3K_TWTQnDz-p7OY5led9cOy3KnL5U9htCTrY9KOqhDucEhUUUolz9wm_iASYpFlcki-Qt7ptsLY3BhvM4enmGmLTEZHGE7g_Ckz3h3JCFbAOlAU0Na7GmZzoLbFWrdgqeYUIoJmxjiQ5EA01zjUPiCPVsNtUoV35Ij9UGpugOzYPgLaVWC6KN5GQPfm2aBNWYAMArKH6Ls0ODt49Vwhg2GKlGxj33YWImKTpNMWdAjoqp8v3GL_vYvLF6TFro8=)–including a convicted rapist. It may ruffle some feathers to say it, but the governor’s approach to crime is making our state less safe. And it may not be “politically correct” but our current president’s border policy is making our state less safe. **We’re here to say the things that have to be said! It’s the mission of the Common Sense Club is to call it like it is.** Are you ready to start speaking up? Join the Common Sense Club today and join thousands of New Jerseyans who are calling out Leftwing lunacy on a state and national level.

Friend, I have two questions for you: have you already voted? Are you ready to help us win? I’m asking you and voters across the North Coast to vote early and to check the box next to “Chris Coulombe.” **Every vote counts**! And in California, voting early is critical if we’re going to defeat all-talk-no-action career politicians like Jared Huffman. Voting early banks your vote in case something comes up on Election Day. Once we see a voter has submitted their ballot, we don’t continue to advertise to them, call them, or knock on their door. **We’re able to shift resources to those who have not yet voted**. Will you help us in our final sprint to the finish line with a [**Get-Out-the-Vote contribution**](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=vLzcBttMlHPwnhM1pQ23paEVimo0rylpeDdAmHdq2BRXYkxl191oSNI1ipoeFSbG9BlVvYFE5eeGPoUwnWKNtA&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=vote&n=2)? We are targeting “low propensity” voters who will choose a new direction for the North Coast — if they vote. And there are many of them. But there isn’t much time left. We must reach people across the 2nd Congressional District who are just starting to focus on the election and remind them what this race is about: **crushing inflation, securing our water and agricultural resources, and restoring public safety**. So many have given so generously this year. Now, we need one final push. POV: You’re outside the hearing that could determine the fate of DACA | | | Peter, I’m at the courthouse today rallying outside of the latest DACA hearing that could decide the fate of myself and hundreds and thousands of DACA recipients just like me. We don’t know when we’ll hear a decision, or what the court will decide, but we have to be prepared for the worst-case scenario. The 5th Circuit Court has ruled against DACA before and they could do so again, and rip away our life-changing protections in the process. But we don’t have to wait for a decision to take action. President Biden and Congress can take action to protect DACA recipients right now, before the decision comes down that could decide our fate. **[We’re applying pressure on our elected officials while preparing for DACA to potentially go before the Supreme Court again. body:
American Muslims reject war-mongering duopoly

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter,

Did you see the email we sent a few days ago about the incredible momentum Jill and Butch are gaining with Muslim Americans? We wanted to make sure you saw it. In a new poll released by the Yaqeen Institute, Kamala and Trump are polling terribly with Muslim Americans, with less than 25% support between the two of them and more than 52% saying they will vote for “someone else.” And, as we know from the recent Council on American Islamic Relations (CAIR) poll, the “someone else” that Muslim Americans prefer is Jill Stein. In the CAIR results from a month ago, Jill polled evenly with Kamala with 29%, while the closest other anti-genocide candidate had only 4.2% support. Notably, Jill is leading Kamala in Muslim American support in three battleground states: Arizona, Michigan, and Wisconsin. It’s fair to say that Jill and Butch’s numbers are skyrocketing with Muslim Americans and other demographics. Another example: just a few days ago, polling from New Hampshire showed 7% of 18-34 year olds are supporting Jill. We expect this momentum to continue. Abandon Harris, formerly Abandon Biden, announced that they endorsed Jill and Butch yesterday. That news was reported everywhere; our historic campaign is breaking through the media blackout. Which means our numbers will keep growing. We are also promoting our new video “[We have the power](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_yi_fe_10_10&n=1)” and the reception has been amazing. But we are still $5,000 short of our goal to spread Jill and Butch’s message of people, planet and peace to voters across the country. We know that Republicans in Congress are looking to use their limited power to enact a national abortion ban. Congressional Republicans have said that they will make sure to pass a national abortion ban if they have the power.
Republicans know their views aren’t popular, but that’s not stopping them from forcing far-right ideology onto the entire country.
The 2024 election is more important than ever. We know that Republicans will be sure to prioritize gutting abortion rights nationwide if they take power.
Our opponent Cliff Bentz has long worked to strip women of their rights. He said that "I believe that life begins at conception and that life should be protected until death by natural causes occurs." He has a radical view on women’s rights that doesn’t represent our state at all.

| If we lose Nevada, we lose the Senate AND the White House. _Tammy Baldwin here — I wanted to make sure you saw this message from James Carville about Senator Jacky Rosen's race in Nevada. Jacky is running for reelection to help defend our Democratic Senate majority, so I hope you'll read this message and[chip in if you can.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-rosen.SC53au&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241010_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=4032%2E35263%2EtB4m_d)_
* * *
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-rosen.SC53au&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241010_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4032%2E35263%2EtB4m_d) Democrats are _sleeping_ on Nevada, Peter! Here are the three reasons why we need to WAKE UP and support Jacky Rosen’s MUST-WIN Senate campaign in this crucial battleground state: 1) Nevada is **always** close. The last Senate race here was decided by under 8,000 votes, which was only 0.77% of the vote – that’s just **_five votes per precinct._** 2) Right now, Jacky Rosen is statistically TIED with her extreme GOP opponent, and _The Cook Political Report_ is calling Nevada the “most perilous” battleground for Democrats. 3) Donald Trump has painted a huge target on Jacky’s back by saying, "If we win Nevada, we win the whole thing” – **and Republicans and their dark money allies have now spent more than $30 MILLION on flipping this crucial battleground seat red!** Trump is right less often than a broken clock, Peter, but he’s spot on about the stakes in Nevada. If we’re going to secure our Democratic majority and the White House, we cannot lose in Nevada. **But with time running out before the election, Jacky Rosen is still way behind her midnight fundraising goal. body:
Miller-Meeks neglected our schools. Christina will fight tooth and nail for better education.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94700506/504311452/177624347?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmY0NDBiMS0yMDg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XRP8flROixfkCs5qEeyj3YCDfHdbMej4LDOOa83w_No=)

Peter,

Iowa's children deserve a representative who prioritizes their education. Unfortunately, **Mariannette Miller-Meeks has failed to deliver.**

Miller-Meeks’ time in office has been marked by conspiracy theories and quack science rather than making education better for Iowa families. She supports Governor Reynolds’ voucher plan. She has verbally attacked teachers in congressional hearings and has voted for congressional budget cuts that would eliminate more than 100,000 teacher jobs.

[**Iowans deserve a Congresswoman who will fight tooth and nail for better education. That's Christina Bohannan. Make a donation today >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94700510/504311464/177624347?refcode=em24_241010_edu_fnd_gq_act___tb_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_241010_edu_fnd_gq_act___tb_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=d6f440b1-2087-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNmY0NDBiMS0yMDg3LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XRP8flROixfkCs5qEeyj3YCDfHdbMej4LDOOa83w_No=)

Growing up in a trailer in a small rural town, Christina understands the challenges many face. As a first-generation college graduate and now a law professor, Christina knows the power of education to transform lives.

**In office, Christina will never give up the fight for education:**
* Strengthen public education for every Iowa child.
* Make higher education and vocational training more affordable.
* Make Iowa number one in public education once again.
* Reinvest in public education at every level: pre-K and K-12 schools, community colleges and universities, and skills training and apprenticeships.
* Guarantee every child access to high-quality education by pushing for a federal bill that invests in public education, with a special focus on rural and small-town schools.
* Expand CTE and career education programs so that students who do not choose to go to college can find good-paying jobs in the trades or manufacturing.

| | America has an affordable housing crisis, and if we don't take action, it's going to get worse. That's why I'm working to stop Wall Street hedge funds from driving up rents and home prices by swooping in and outbidding regular folks with all-cash, no-inspection, over-the-asking-price offers. The 2008 housing crisis was fueled by predatory private mortgages and unregulated markets, and Wall Street hedge funds ruthlessly gobbled up large portfolios of foreclosed homes, profiting off the devastation of ordinary Americans. With the federal government facilitating this corporate greed through bulk sales of federally backed mortgages and foreclosed properties, hard-working families were shut out of recovering housing stability. **It was flat-out wrong.** All over the country, including right here in Oregon, hedge funds are wielding their financial muscle to snatch up available housing – in particular, starter homes – outbid ordinary Americans, spike prices and rents, and turn neighborhoods into Wall Street profit centers at the expense of folks struggling to find a place to call home. My _End Hedge Fund Control of American Homes Act_ will kick hedge funds out of the housing market and increase access to affordable housing. Here's what my legislation does: it bans hedge funds from owning single-family homes and forces hedge funds and other large private investors to sell their inventory of single-family homes to families who don't currently own a home. If the hedge funds don't, they are required to pay a substantial tax penalty that funds a down payment assistance program. We need to stop Wall Street from putting profits before people because everyone should have a safe, affordable place to call home. We're working to get it done! clean_body: I’m working to stop Wall Street hedge funds from driving up rents and home prices by swooping in and outbidding regular folks with all-cash, no-inspection, over-the-asking-price offers. | | | | America has an affordable housing crisis, and if we don't take action, it's going to get worse. That's why I'm working to stop Wall Street hedge funds from driving up rents and home prices by swooping in and outbidding regular folks with all-cash, no-inspection, over-the-asking-price offers. The 2008 housing crisis was fueled by predatory private mortgages and unregulated markets, and Wall Street hedge funds ruthlessly gobbled up large portfolios of foreclosed homes, profiting off the devastation of ordinary Americans. With the federal government facilitating this corporate greed through bulk sales of federally backed mortgages and foreclosed properties, hard-working families were shut out of recovering housing stability. It was flat-out wrong. All over the country, including right here in Oregon, hedge funds are wielding their financial muscle to snatch up available housing – in particular, starter homes – outbid ordinary Americans, spike prices and rents, and turn neighborhoods into Wall Street profit centers at the expense of folks struggling to find a place to call home. My End Hedge Fund Control of American Homes Act will kick hedge funds out of the housing market and increase access to affordable housing. Here's what my legislation does: it bans hedge funds from owning single-family homes and forces hedge funds and other large private investors to sell their inventory of single-family homes to families who don't currently own a home. If the hedge funds don't, they are required to pay a substantial tax penalty that funds a down payment assistance program. We need to stop Wall Street from putting profits before people because everyone should have a safe, affordable place to call home. We're working to get it done! Onward! # Spokane Editor Calls Senate Debate “Amazing,” Best He’s Ever Seen
---
| In his first ever televised debate, Dr Garcia knocked it out of the park on Tuesday in Spokane! Facing off against incumbent Sen. Maria Cantwell at Gonzaga University, Raul more than held his own in a one-hour event that covered a wide range of issues.
The Spokesman-Review’s executive editor, Rob Curley, praised the debate, saying:
_“I’ve been in journalism for almost 30 years. I’ve never seen a debate like I just saw. Civil discourse, where people outlined what they really believed, and no one was angry. I was blown away – I was so proud to see it. It was amazing. And you all were a huge part of that.”_
Here’s a video of his remarks:
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=126c3912d8&e=3ed3552a03)
|
---
|
# Watch the Full Spokane Debate
---
| You can watch the full U.S. Senate debate held in Spokane this past Tuesday, Oct. 8, by clicking the link below. Many thanks to the debate hosts: The Spokesman-Review, Northwest Passages, Spokane Public Television, Gonzaga University, The Black Lens and the Washington Debate Coalition. And thanks to everyone who attended!

[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=758a0526af&e=3ed3552a03)
|

# Live TV Debate in Seattle Oct. 17
---
| It took awhile, but Sen. Cantwell finally agreed to a [televised debate in Seattle](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=fc0bfcce4c&e=3ed3552a03). It will be next Thursday, Oct. 17, at 12 Noon at KIRO-7 TV studios in Seattle. KIRO will livestream and live broadcast the debate. KIRO-7’s website is [here](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=d49d2f5f7e&e=3ed3552a03).
The debate sponsors, the League of Women Voters of Washington and KIRO-7 TV, are asking voters to send in questions for the debate. Submit yours at [www.kiro7.com/debate](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=4a3a60ad03&e=3ed3552a03) or by emailing [forumquestion@lwvwa.org](mailto:forumquestion@lwvwa.org?subject=U.S.%20Senate%20debate%20question&body=). See the graphic below for question guidelines:
---
[](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=6257ea1775&e=3ed3552a03)
|

# Voting Starts in 8 Days:
# Help Dr Garcia in the Home Stretch!
---
| With Dr Garcia’s stellar debate performance in Spokane, another televised debate in Seattle coming up, and our highly effective ads which are running now, Dr Garcia is making a big impression with the swing voters who are crucial to winning the election.
Voting begins and ballots are mailed out next Friday, Oct. 18!
[Your continued financial support](https://garciaforwa.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe0c756dc01af594bb0bab517&id=cc037a4ccf&e=3ed3552a03) will enable us to finish strong and finally replace Sen. Maria Cantwell with a U.S. Senator who will listen to the people of Washington and bring the change we need to get our great state back on track.

subject: Sign the Petition: Urge presidential candidates to support Israel!
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow American,

In July, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke before
a joint session of Congress. The night before, FRC Action
Chairman Tony Perkins had the privilege of meeting with the prime
minister and letting him know that many Bible-believing
Christians are praying for him, Israel, and the Jewish people.

After the horrific October 7 terrorist attack by Hamas, we have
seen antisemitism on display in our nation's cities and on
college campuses. We stand against this evil. As Prime Minister
Netanyahu said, "Wherever and whenever we see the scourge of
antisemitism, we must fight it, without exception."

As Israel fights for its survival, it is more important now
than ever that the United States stand with our ally. Israel
should be able to count on our support in its fight for its
survival. Sign the petition below encouraging President Biden and
American presidential candidates to commit to supporting Israel.

Sign the Pledge Now

To President Biden and the Presidential Candidates:

It is of great importance that the next president of the United
States commits to stand with our greatest ally in the Middle
East, Israel.

For decades, there has been bipartisan support for Israel.
Sadly, ever since the October 7 attack against Israel by Hamas
terrorists, this support has been put into question.

Given the existential threat Israel is facing, it should be a
priority of the current chief executive and every presidential
candidate to be loud and clear about their support for Israel.

We ask that you affirm America's commitment to Israel's
security and ensure that Israel maintains a qualitative military
edge over any and all adversaries.

We ask that you support Israel's right and obligation to defend
itself against terror attacks upon its people and against
alternative forms of warfare being waged upon it legally,
economically, culturally, and otherwise.

We ask that you make clear to the Israeli government that you
will be a willing partner in their fight for survival.

Sign the Pledge

God Bless,

Jody Hice

President, FRC Action

Dear Peter, With just 26 days to go until Election Day -- and early voting already underway in many states -- I wanted to reach out to you directly with an update on where we stand in this race, how we plan to win it, and what you can do to help. [_**If you’re ready to get started, join us. Click here to find an upcoming Team Harris-Walz event that works for your schedule >>**_](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxR9IXPCsluZXFBWW-0djqjtwe7pWAlNLOAlXq3P770lSueeMvPRuFacVTh4oCOiVG3zw4tTVgCDtqEefB4l6uq6kyibz-U-lKB7Mrk-VceS50bcp9YHZHr-N-5HHZl40TPWEX1iQIF1jCKtmAotqwiqjlxu1e0fauzCbXY9x8g7PGkdIYyaFIeSGJslwI-voPAUkoGw1P7B_n6ohaBNWMS9vbCtF6NrSLttrR7SgVNdSu7T6rPqmT15EAy_isV7breMJZhtp-BDJf-c8_0DppSuKkzsTlynbq3ub65MPqkKerLfF7OU4Z5ERfTpvGnicHg/4ah/lVWUKQ3gSTuHWu0D13PE3w/h1/h001.QFvPxujYzQXStu9NA7_ohI9rJHoCI15uNOg1B-hoPhQ) **__**
* * *
**_Here's where we stand:_**
Kamala Harris has always been the underdog in this race. She is running against a former president with an incredibly loyal base of supporters, many of whom are billionaires who have donated tens or even hundreds of millions of dollars to outside groups supporting his campaign. We expect to be outspent in this race. We can win if we’re outspent, but we cannot win if we’re out-organized. That’s why we’ve hired thousands of organizers across the country -- including in critical states like Pennsylvania -- and have built the largest digital organizing operation in campaign history to ensure we’re reaching every voter we can. To every single person who’s been a part of that -- thank you. Every single door knock, phone call, and social media post is a meaningful contribution to this campaign. Thanks to your work, we are entering the home stretch of this race in a strong position. We are effectively tied in 7 battleground states -- Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Nevada, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina -- with a small advantage in some and a small but surmountable deficit in others. We are also aggressively campaigning in Nebraska’s Second Congressional District, which could prove decisive. Remember that we won in 2020 by a margin of about 40,000 votes across the battleground states -- we expect another razor-thin election, and our strategy is to compete everywhere, expand the map, and maximize the number of pathways to victory so that we can win this election even if not every swing state goes our way. **_Here’s what we need to do between now and Election Day:_**
1. Reach every single undecided voter and make sure they know Kamala’s vision, values, and life story -- and the night-and-day contrast between her record of fighting for middle-class families and Donald Trump’s record of fighting for himself and his rich friends.
2. Continue to build relationships with people who support us but may not have decided whether to vote, particularly people of color and young people. It’s on us to earn, not just count on, their vote, and make sure they know when, where, and how they can do it quickly and easily.
3. Peel off Trump supporters where we can. Picture that person in your life who voted for Trump in 2016 or 2020 even though they know he’s dangerous and a liar, and who hasn’t yet been convinced that, yes, it’s ok to turn the page. There are pockets of these voters in critical states, they are gettable, and we will get them.
4. Convert Harris supporters into volunteers and grassroots validators for this campaign. _This is where you come in._

**_What you can do:_** I’ll be blunt: We need more supporters to raise their hands and say they’re ready to volunteer, and we need those who’ve already done so to keep their foot on the gas. We know we have the best candidate. But without grassroots energy we could very easily lose this race and find ourselves facing another four years of Donald Trump. A Donald Trump that is more extreme than ever before. We cannot let it happen. [_**There are lots of ways to volunteer -- on the ground, on the phone, even on social media -- and our team is here to make sure it’s a smooth (and fun!) experience.**_](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxR9IXPCsluZXFBWW-0djqjtwe7pWAlNLOAlXq3P770lSueeMvPRuFacVTh4oCOiVG3zw4tTVgCDtqEefB4l6uq6kyibz-U-lKB7Mrk-VceS50bcp9YHZHr-N-5HHZl40TCHRRj-3Y_cY7UihTMEs_U5KYu_q6Wrgj90d4q8ul5X_bHhPm2iCAgQYXfQbMozrjNYJUpekc3yVltwL4yMnsl94JzcyhizrDtMFu5yJzUibf5pA3Gacy2DEu1OPsOQQVjoG705Rxjo-vZePWp5qSucQWEg33097SyXb3-RDabMGdXjOMaGcpk2-260zOkPcZg/4ah/lVWUKQ3gSTuHWu0D13PE3w/h2/h001.RvH7YUboZrR5rFl6FR0tyZYR1gZz-DQ2nUJrVyBSGvE) | | [VOLUNTEER](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxR9IXPCsluZXFBWW-0djqjtwe7pWAlNLOAlXq3P770lSueeMvPRuFacVTh4oCOiVG3zw4tTVgCDtqEefB4l6uq6kyibz-U-lKB7Mrk-VceS50bcp9YHZHr-N-5HHZl40TN4b4lXXOFqWeGm1qnqte-91Tea0nQQ0iaeZV9hdWNDiXtGBTLE2oGuVvl7T4TaJGe7LjFgeOjX5wTpdYp-YOUOzhHiNVOnDeN57q3ch-vYJUlaY1-wa9vxz5D0NV_kDqutvbEfwVAzeFrY2A-smpWVE4b5U3RYccnL-unUu4y2HpuBq4ZArweMLyhYSScO9Zg/4ah/lVWUKQ3gSTuHWu0D13PE3w/h3/h001.wVoSevMiLcWCAPTsWMWaLBFxQkpz6UafwfW93hBsso4)

You’ll get all the training you’ll need, you’ll meet fellow volunteers, and you’ll have meaningful conversations with voters about the direction of this country we all love. And the best part is you’ll know that you’ve done what you could to elect Kamala Harris and stop Donald Trump.

Jen

What you can do: I’ll be blunt: We need more supporters to raise their hands and say they’re ready to volunteer, and we need those who’ve already done so to keep their foot on the gas. We know we have the best candidate. But without grassroots energy we could very easily lose this race and find ourselves facing another four years of Donald Trump. A Donald Trump that is more extreme than ever before. We cannot let it happen. | | Whether you’re a longtime volunteer or brand new to this cause but excited about our campaign -- we want and deeply appreciate your help. We’ll make sure that your time is used as strategically as possible, whether you have whole days to spend volunteering or just 5 minutes here and there. You’ll get all the training you’ll need, you’ll meet fellow volunteers, and you’ll have meaningful conversations with voters about the direction of this country we all love. And the best part is you’ll know that you’ve done what you could to elect Kamala Harris and stop Donald Trump. I hope you’ll join us. Now let’s go win this thing. Jen Jen O'Malley Dillon Chair, Harris for President | | | |

These 64 Democracy Defenders — from races in Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, and Wisconsin — are dedicated to protecting the fundamental rights of the American people:
* **In Arizona** , Republicans hold just a two-seat majority in both the State House and Senate. If we can help get out the vote and win a majority in both chambers, we can build power that can be used to strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
* **In Michigan** , we have the opportunity to help Democrats keep their trifecta, which will protect the state’s redistricting reform and allow for more landmark policies to protect the freedoms of Michiganders statewide.
* **In Minnesota** , we’re also working to protect this state’s Democratic trifecta. A single special election will determine control of the Minnesota State Senate, and Republicans only need to flip five seats in the House to regain power here.
* **In New Hampshire** , Republicans have a trifecta, but we have a real chance to flip that on its head. Not only can we win majorities in the legislature, where Republicans are defending tiny majorities —**now, we’re adding the governor’s race to our priority list!** The state House is rated a toss-up and the Senate is considered to be within reach. If they hold on to their Republican trifecta, the legislature could redraw its congressional map at any moment. A flip here is critical to put GOP gerrymandering to rest.
* **In Wisconsin** , where this year fair legislative maps _finally_ became a reality, we have a chance at flipping the State Assembly — our best shot in a generation. We can also make real progress in the State Senate. This is a state where the other side is eager to roll back our progress. Let’s fight to protect it.

**Our state-by-state strategy relies on people like you who believe in safeguarding democracy — and know that so much hinges on key state-level races.[Will you chip in $30 right now to help power this critical work and elect Democracy Defenders across the country?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94723035/504360298/1485360112?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_Wave5Endorsements_email_20241010-NDRC-Tier1-Wave5Endorsements_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241010-NDRC-Tier1-Wave5Endorsements_&utm_campaign=Wave5Endorsements&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhNTBhYjdkLTI5ODctZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BDcAOv8YmJmNxT-AbF982ASbJF6SyZ26LvgPV1hLgP0=)**
Thank you so much,
Claire
Claire Low

## Milton Makes Landfall, Floods Florida
Hurricane Milton made landfall near Sarasota last night as a Category 3 storm with 115 mph winds, flooding the middle of the state and leaving at least 1.6 million people without power. [Follow live updates.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFy6yAQRb8GdXhgWQu5oHiNOr82pWYFi0WChAZhe_L3GeUDcovbnObM-bhPd0o5bY__tLJrsUzkW3rxlM_TSmolASfsgovMwKZjpy0M18GYAbvFwdz310FZ62PvaTbeo0E9WK-D8ZbmLjlQgFpppa1RGi-R6DYD3jyhBrKzQMUhtVIvnyVtbeGYv8uL68WXtctuaW0_hPknYBQw0r7x-ziRgPF0FDAuz1qTp43lmnIrm4y51BRItkr-i6t87oEaHwKMOqdvIC1qkiEalGTDLCMG9rqnE3fVhf2dck5HbwWqx0op_8q0vwK9HPwEAAD__-EqaOU)The storm was downgraded to Category 2 less than two hours after making landfall. Over a foot of rain fell in many areas, and the entire Tampa Bay area was under flash flood warnings last night.Millions of residents evacuated ahead of the storm. Stranded tourists and hurricane evacuees have filled all of Orlando's 100,000 hotel rooms. It's unclear how soon people will be able to return to their homes.Ahead of the hurricane, tornadic supercells, dangerous rotating thunderstorms capable of producing tornadoes, spawned multiple tornadoes across southern Florida. [Watch a video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFuhDAQRL8GOiN7MQdXuEhDd2lTogWvj40W-2QcSP4-ulyfZqQZjfSk93GbbsjC8f6OG7kS0oRL4YMmeYbRymgFdrK1d4EIqK3JmR6Gbmjbwdar8x2ES2v6C844DF533WKwAz1QsLPHpWYHGqzRRpu-1cY2AfE6g70uaA1gP1dWk-eScvOZOJaVgvykg3KzpK0Wt5by2Kv2rYKxgvE8zyak75OwrK_Lc3w1FencKxgP9pR2VVKO6BPtKkjK7FGtXznzgpHUxlJSVILRBxSps_OPk0V4v_SV1fcNWf745T8nh4PfAAAA__89d2m6).Gov. Ron DeSantis [mobilized thousands of rescue personnel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL2O2zAQhJ-G6mgsV5RlFSzSqHPalMJSXFqb8MeQGBt3T3_QPcA1Uw2-GXx_7sudJEl5_KbMrsW60NrkxUs6w4A2oNEutgsuMiP3HTsz4m249f3NdpvrjTcjXjnylQaYBlwH9n5gPwL3PIVOHAJaAwbM2IOxl0g0ebTTStYgjV5Z4CCt7pe_VUrbOKaP-uL9stbcJbe19jxU_0vhrHCOHHinVPh9FG7vuv87awrnwJHLwTqTFIXzualwNqBwPmF6AABdqEktlPTjP-1BZ86e90Pn6iXJJwdNG1PQNeosqdUT1O0uPN-SkhzXUVl4ZJL0fa39pOvl8CsAAP__jz9wCQ), National Guard members, and utility workers to respond to the impending disaster.
## FBI Foils Election Terror Plot
Oklahoma officials confirmed on Wednesday the arrest of a Moore [high school student](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL3SmzAQAJ9GdGL0B8KFijR0TpuSOaTDXCyQR5xh_PYZ5wG-ZpttdvbPfboDZdofv2HDwEuZIDKdOOUvtJJaSeMm16SwIBq0DQbtzdAN1g6uWUMPnZ2tuWk9xA58j1r7uNjZLYvubA8NBaOM00or7a3Srl0AbrNxtwhOG_CzcAoTcant30I7r7jkTzmxtrFsTQ4r8-sQ9pcwozDjdV3ts8TylcKMUJliRmHGkyq_IcujvHndSqkoD34n3FlCrXgwJokZI1PZZYKPZKy1VDpYAjPEp3xl2OUOB1UJ6wZJMlwrJhJm7E3Xea9VU0N6XZQzHb0XTj02oPy_k396dwbzLwAA__9X3HaE) as a co-conspirator in a foiled ISIS-linked terrorist attack plot in the United States.The unnamed juvenile was arrested when he and suspected terrorist Nasir Ahmad Tawhedi met with an FBI asset in rural Oklahoma to purchase assault rifles and ammunition. According to [a federal criminal complaint](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFuhDAQRL_GdEb24jugcJGG7tKmRAteH5v48MleHbq_j8gHpBnNaDTS6H3d5hty4v3-iQ_yEvOMq_CL5nSKNdoaDW52TfCRCKhryNsehsvQdYNrNg9DNwQyo4tES8QRL10Irh9h7OG6xNiwBwPOGmts3xnr2og4LuDGFZ0F7BflDAWWXNrvzLtsFNM7v6i0a340yW8iz6q6DwWTguk4jnZd6k5HPXsF02kVTBjvG-56R-G8Y9JYClWhoLly1YUSnkGolFy4ikYRXH80JVrPhQ74VjA1xYfnwSlxvfbKmfsDOf0dkf_gvDz8BgAA___5oWx1), the juvenile is Tawhedi's brother-in-law, and both are followers of ISIS. They also attempted to sell their family home and relocate their families abroad. Tawhedi [faces charges of ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kDFu6zAQRE9DdRTI5dqiCxa_UeffphTW0srahBYNamHFtw-UA6SZZgaDh_dxHa4kWdb7f3pw0rkMNKq8eMhHeGe9s4ADNlOamYFDw8l3EE8xhIjNkuZIY8AQTx0SuvPlHBmRo_dduFFw1EgCB-idd74LzmM7E11ugJeR0AN1N4OOJ9FS288iqy4853d5cW3H8mhyWlSfmwn_DPQG-n3fW_qWsh2tgf74NtB7Z6B30UBP832h1a6kUlbKlmrlTXmyyrWWKptaUqXxy3Lm8RjZid5NTdNzl5xlO3cG3f1Bkn8B9C8prwQ_AQAA__9Zk2Yb)conspiring and attempting to provide material support to ISIS, carrying a maximum 20-year sentence, and receiving a firearm for committing a felony or federal terrorism crime, punishable by up to 15 years in prison.
## Orange Rolling With Vance, Walz
Reporters embedded with vice-presidential candidates JD Vance and Tim Walz revived the [tradition of orange rolling](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL-O8yAQxJ8Gd1iwkOAUFF_jLl97pcWfJeGOgAXI6O7pT84DXLP6aUcazczHfbubmGJ-_Dcv1D2UzbgeD9zSeTijnFGQm5y8DoiAYkLNFSyXRYhFTk-9OLUIz0AGZr0KFwR_FUpIcRHKMhemqIGB5IwzrgTjcg7G3CzImzOSg1GWSIY-9lLnzxJzf2JI3-XAOrvympJ-9r43Iv4RWAmsY4zZ2ZZxtFMnsJ5IYK24l9qxNppLR1vKFx0m_dDDZIe0VJMfSG0ZZ1faq_Gxx5JPOvD92yu2Rl2p-2k3Ve33EVOK7aqIZI-XiemdqP-10qHhNwAA__-JxW_F) in an effort to lighten things up during a particularly intense election.Orange rolling is [a decades-old tradition](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL-O8yAQxJ8Gd1iwkOAUFF_jLl97pcWfJeGOgAXI6O7pT84DXLP6aUcazczHfbubmGJ-_Dcv1D2UzbgeD9zSeTijnFGQm5y8DoiAYkLNFSyXRYhFTk-9OLUIz0AGZr0KFwR_FUpIcRHKMhemqIGB5IwzrgTjcg7G3CzImzOSg1GWSIY-9lLnzxJzf2JI3-XAOrvympJ-9r43Iv4RWAmsY4zZ2ZZxtFMnsJ5IYK24l9qxNppLR1vKFx0m_dDDZIe0VJMfSG0ZZ1faq_Gxx5JPOvD92yu2Rl2p-2k3Ve33EVOK7aqIZI-XiemdqP-10qHhNwAA__-JxW_F) dating back to President Ronald Reagan, involving the press corps writing a question on an orange and rolling it up the plane's aisle to the candidate, who writes his answer on the orange and rolls it back.During a Sunday flight, [a CBS News reporter asked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kL1qwzAURp9G3mT0cxPbg4ZC8ZbSraO5lq-dW2TJSMIhffqSPkCXb_k4cDhft-mGHDhuH7iTq2ua0Fc-aQqv0UpqJQ1M0CxuJTJkG3K6M_2lt7aH5u461c-XC-gVsOsAAP2wWjuvS--XYZ6pYWeUAa200p1VGtoVcZgNDB5BG-xmAYoWrim334ljvdManumk3Pq0N8Hdaz2KsG_CjMKMOPtIj9Ju6XULM36mwJV9EWY8MXqSDww_8shUivQpH0VmOvkkWTMuXDlF6XE_kLcoj4CRXmSpKT-FHXkR9l1ruBpQpm-yW44Hh8Dl2glQ244c_qzqf6VOZ34DAAD__-wnbtI) Walz for his _Dream dinner guest._ Walz rolled the orange back a day later with _Bruce Springsteen_ written in black marker.On Tuesday, it was Vance's turn. Flying from his campaign event in Detroit, the press wrote _Fave Song_? on an orange. Vance responded within minutes with Led Zeppelin's _Ten Years Gone_.

Team, last week I walked off the debate stage and reached out for your support. Since then, the online donations have been _pouring in_.

I’m running for Senate again because I believe that Montana is the best state in the best country in the world, and our way of life is worth defending.

Tim Sheehy doesn’t care about any of that. He’s just another multimillionaire who moved here to play cowboy. **Mitch McConnell knows this, which is why he’s spending nearly $90 million to prop up his personal yes‐man.**

How do we decide which judge deserves our vote? With politicians it is easier because we can look at their voting record. But with judges, who has time to read lengthy court opinions, much less make sense of what they mean in ordinary language? As an attorney, I don't want judges on the bench who lack ethics or respect for our core values of equal justice before the law. So, I write this to provide readers with a clear outline of how to properly evaluate your judges before giving them your sacred vote. And yes, your vote is sacred, so you should safeguard it closely.
In my home state of Illinois, judges are elected. This helps ensure voters have more control over our courts. The downside is the outsized influence by right wing donors and judges on the national level to help elect right wing judges on the local and state level. And rather than tell you, let me show you an example of what's happening in my own local/state judicial election right now. This is a terrifying example of how a lawyer trained by pro MAGA SCOTUS Justice Clarance Thomas is attempting to become an Illinois appellate judge by less than ethical means. How do we prevent this from happening? **Let 's Address This.**

---|---|---
Justice Clarence Thomas has a record of decades of corruption.
### Three Questions To Ask When Evaluating Judges
Let me start by saying if you're in Illinois and in the counties of Dupage, Will, Grundy, LaSalle, Kankakee, Iroquois, or Bureau, you should vote for [Judge John Anderson for appellate court](https://substack.com/redirect/6c8fc11e-f6e3-4b00-a28a-f3e731a56ebb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I can personally vouch for his character, integrity, legal scholarship, and fairness. But this article is not about a campaign endorsement, it's about informing voters on how to elect good judges.
This matters. Bad judges got us Citizens United, flooding our politics with corrupt dark money. Bad judges gutted the EPA, decimating our climate protection. Bad judges overturned Roe v Wade, making life hell for tens of millions of women nationwide. Bad judges gutted the Voting Rights Act, reviving Jim Crow fascism. Bad judges gave Donald Trump immunity, giving him dictatorial powers. And those same bad judges, like Clarence Thomas who made each of the aforementioned atrocious rulings, are now trying to elect a man named Kenton Skarin to the Illinois Appeals Court. We cannot let that happen.
As you vote in this election, or any election, vet judges with these three key questions:
1. Who trained the judge on the ballot?
2. What are that judge's _full_ qualifications and ratings?
3. In attacking their opponent on issues unrelated to their judicial qualifications, what is this judge trying to hide about their own record?

Let's apply these questions to a real life example of Kenton Skarin's campaign against Judge John Anderson.
### The Dangers of Judicial Candidate Kenton Skarin's Lies by Omission
At first glance, Kenton Skarin's campaign tries to paint him as a judge who give "fair results, not politics." Unfortunately, his record speaks to quite the contrary. Skarin's campaign has been marked by lies of omission that mislead voters about his own record, while attacking the character of Judge John Anderson. This lack of transparency is not just troubling--it should be disqualifying for anyone seeking to serve on the Illinois Appellate Court. Below I share three examples of Skarin's lies by omission, and how you as the voter can spot them going forward.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4eK8k0sDcQqLBc3xRE24fMbXjyg3K7p5CqMLzgTQncA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149841724)
### Lie by Omission #1: Skarin Hides Who Trained Him To Be A Judge
Skarin has gone to great lengths to brag about his experience clerking for the U.S. Supreme Court, writing on his website, "_Judge Skarin clerked for the**United States Supreme Court**_." (emphasis his). Remarkably, Skarin refuses to acknowledge that he clerked for Justice Clarence Thomas--[a man mired in controversy and corruption](https://substack.com/redirect/4a0cd818-a2d9-469c-9eef-cbf362029056?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Justice Thomas has faced numerous allegations of accepting unethical gifts and bribes, has [refused to recuse himself despite clear conflicts of interest](https://substack.com/redirect/cc5427db-c23a-4cb9-857a-d5805076f686?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [and his wife was involved in efforts to overturn the 2020 election](https://substack.com/redirect/00d2b19b-f23b-4f29-bf14-fcb0b0e6fd63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). How close is Kenton Skarin to Justice Thomas? Close enough that [Justice Thomas flew to DuPage County to attend Skarin's swearing in to the bench](https://substack.com/redirect/2db29c9e-29a8-42ab-b147-544724a4d819?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Dupage County auditor Bob Grogan wrote:
> Congrats to our two newest DuPage Judges, Kenton Skarin and Michael Fleming. We had the added honor of having US Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas and IL Supreme Court Justice Bob Thomas give wonderfully insightful, humble, and humorous remarks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c5863d7c-5779-4fba-b017-f6f0f28d471c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2019, Justice Thomas flew to DuPage County, Illinois to attend Kenton Skarin's swearing in ceremony to the DuPage County bench.
Skarin's failure to mention this significant part of his background on his campaign website speaks volumes. If he's so proud of his Supreme Court clerkship, why omit the fact that it was with one of the most corrupt justices in modern history? Most recently, [Justice Thomas ruled to give Trump effective Presidential immunity from criminal behavior](https://substack.com/redirect/92601d47-36e8-4776-83b7-029a781839b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a staple of The Heritage Foundation's fascist Project 2025 initiative. It is of no surprise, therefore, that when Kenton Skarin worked in the Governor Rauner administration, he engaged with The Heritage Foundation on their anti-Union efforts.
In short, Clarance Thomas is the Judge who trained Kenton Skarin, a fact Skarin goes at great lengths to hide. Electing Skarin is effectively electing a protege of Thomas--someone who shares his values and judgment (or lack thereof). Illinois cannot afford a judge who has learned from, and written opinions for, a man so deeply corrupt.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4eK8k0sDcQqLBc3xRE24fMbXjyg3K7p5CqMLzgTQncA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149841724)
### Lie by Omission #2: Skarin Misleads Voters About His Qualifications
Another key misrepresentation in Skarin's campaign is his focus on bar poll scores--where he claims superiority over Judge Anderson. Skarin misleads voters, because bar poll scores are just one aspect of the Illinois State Bar Association's (ISBA) full rating system. These polls do not paint the full picture of a judge's qualifications.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82670d24-c058-4898-9479-5d12749ea133?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Screen grab of Kenton Skarin's ad, falsely alleging he is a higher rated judge than John John Anderson.
The [overall ISBA evaluation](https://substack.com/redirect/76524582-5045-4455-9834-0278217b4335?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) covers 12 criteria, not just the three that Skarin cites. Accordingly, the ISBA gave Judge Anderson the highest possible rating: "_Highly Recommended_." Skarin, on the other hand, received only a "_Recommended_ " rating from the ISBA. Below is what a full picture of the two judicial candidates _actually_ looks like--once we remove Kenton Skarin's distorted view.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ed3b3d5-87be-4eeb-8b9c-515c67e55286?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Accurate head to head comparison between Judge John Anderson and Kenton Skarin.
In addition to the higher rating, Judge Anderson has nearly double the years of legal experience, four times the number of degrees, and the only judge on the ballot to have argued before the Illinois Supreme Court or have reported cases argued before the Illinois Appellate Court. It's clear why Skarin attempts to hide this from voters.
Consider this: If Kenton Skarin refuses to acknowledge the full picture on something as straight forward as judicial qualifications between himself and his opponent, how can he be trusted to acknowledge the full picture when hearing complex cases that can make or break someone's life or livelihood? The answer is, he cannot be trusted. We would not accept that misleading behavior in a job interview, and it isn't behavior we should accept of a person seeking the prestigious office of appellate judge.
In short, Judge Anderson's "Highly Recommended" rating speaks to his integrity, experience, and overall fitness for the role--qualities Skarin cannot match.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..4eK8k0sDcQqLBc3xRE24fMbXjyg3K7p5CqMLzgTQncA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=149841724)
### Lie by Omission #3: Skarin Attacks Judge Anderson's Past While Hoping Voters Ignore His Own
It would be one thing if Kenton Skarin critiqued Judge Anderson's rulings or record on the bench--but he doesn't. Instead, the only 'dirt' he can find on his opponent are traffic violations from literally the last century. If traffic tickets disqualify someone from being a judge, why is Skarin silent about Justice Thomas' dozens of ethics violations for taking bribes from billionaire Harlon Crow, among others? While Judge Anderson owns up to his past mistakes and shows a commitment to self-improvement, Skarin's omission of his deep ties to Thomas suggests a lack of transparency and accountability. Why does Skarin attack Judge Anderson's driving record? Because he knows Judge Anderson's record on the bench is stellar and unassailable, and the 'worst' thing about him is traffic infractions from his youth. If anything, this is an admission from Skarin about Judge Anderson's good judgment and good character, and voters should take note.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9e51b3e9-02b0-4bcf-937c-0e82d3f70f1e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, Skarin's association with MAGA Justice Thomas should be a red flag for anyone concerned with ethics and judicial integrity. Skarin's campaign ad claims he puts 'fairness above politics'--yet he attacks Judge Anderson for his decades old driving record while ignoring his own mentor's decades of corruption currently destroying our republic. That's both unfair, and pure politics. In short, we need judges who recognize fairness is about your actions, not empty words, and Skarin does not pass that test.
### Conclusion: Illinois Deserves Judge John Anderson
Kenton Skarin is scaring voters into voting for him. We must reject the fear mongering. Skarin's lies by omission--about his mentorship with Justice Clarence Thomas, his misleading focus on bar poll scores, and his meritless attacks on Judge Anderson--are individually disqualifying, and collectively mortifying.
I hope you found value in this case study of how to properly evaluate judges before casting your ballot. Illinois cannot afford to place a protege of Clarence Thomas on the Appellate Court. The stakes are too high. We've seen the harm bad judges can do, and that's why we need to elect good judges like Judge John Anderson in Illinois, and around the country.
