Here's how - a case study | | | Oct 10 | | | | | | | | | | | | How do we decide which judge deserves our vote? With politicians it is easier because we can look at their voting record. But with judges, who has time to read lengthy court opinions, much less make sense of what they mean in ordinary language? As an attorney, I don't want judges on the bench who lack ethics or respect for our core values of equal justice before the law. So, I write this to provide readers with a clear outline of how to properly evaluate your judges before giving them your sacred vote. And yes, your vote is sacred, so you should safeguard it closely. In my home state of Illinois, judges are elected. This helps ensure voters have more control over our courts. The downside is the outsized influence by right wing donors and judges on the national level to help elect right wing judges on the local and state level. And rather than tell you, let me show you an example of what's happening in my own local/state judicial election right now. This is a terrifying example of how a lawyer trained by pro MAGA SCOTUS Justice Clarance Thomas is attempting to become an Illinois appellate judge by less than ethical means. How do we prevent this from happening? Let 's Address This. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. | | ---|---|--- Justice Clarence Thomas has a record of decades of corruption. Three Questions To Ask When Evaluating Judges Let me start by saying if you're in Illinois and in the counties of Dupage, Will, Grundy, LaSalle, Kankakee, Iroquois, or Bureau, you should vote for . I can personally vouch for his character, integrity, legal scholarship, and fairness. But this article is not about a campaign endorsement, it's about informing voters on how to elect good judges. This matters. Bad judges got us Citizens United, flooding our politics with corrupt dark money. Bad judges gutted the EPA, decimating our climate protection. Bad judges overturned Roe v Wade, making life hell for tens of millions of women nationwide. Bad judges gutted the Voting Rights Act, reviving Jim Crow fascism. Bad judges gave Donald Trump immunity, giving him dictatorial powers. And those same bad judges, like Clarence Thomas who made each of the aforementioned atrocious rulings, are now trying to elect a man named Kenton Skarin to the Illinois Appeals Court. We cannot let that happen. As you vote in this election, or any election, vet judges with these three key questions: 1. Who trained the judge on the ballot? 2. What are that judge's full qualifications and ratings? 3. In attacking their opponent on issues unrelated to their judicial qualifications, what is this judge trying to hide about their own record? Let's apply these questions to a real life example of Kenton Skarin's campaign against Judge John Anderson. The Dangers of Judicial Candidate Kenton Skarin's Lies by Omission At first glance, Kenton Skarin's campaign tries to paint him as a judge who give "fair results, not politics." Unfortunately, his record speaks to quite the contrary. Skarin's campaign has been marked by lies of omission that mislead voters about his own record, while attacking the character of Judge John Anderson. This lack of transparency is not just troubling--it should be disqualifying for anyone seeking to serve on the Illinois Appellate Court. Below I share three examples of Skarin's lies by omission, and how you as the voter can spot them going forward. Lie by Omission #1: Skarin Hides Who Trained Him To Be A Judge Skarin has gone to great lengths to brag about his experience clerking for the U.S. Supreme Court, writing on his website, "Judge Skarin clerked for theUnited States Supreme Court." (emphasis his). Remarkably, Skarin refuses to acknowledge that he clerked for Justice Clarence Thomas--. Justice Thomas has faced numerous allegations of accepting unethical gifts and bribes, has , . How close is Kenton Skarin to Justice Thomas? Close enough that . Dupage County auditor Bob Grogan wrote: Congrats to our two newest DuPage Judges, Kenton Skarin and Michael Fleming. We had the added honor of having US Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas and IL Supreme Court Justice Bob Thomas give wonderfully insightful, humble, and humorous remarks. | | ---|---|--- In 2019, Justice Thomas flew to DuPage County, Illinois to attend Kenton Skarin's swearing in ceremony to the DuPage County bench. Skarin's failure to mention this significant part of his background on his campaign website speaks volumes. If he's so proud of his Supreme Court clerkship, why omit the fact that it was with one of the most corrupt justices in modern history? Most recently, staple of The Heritage Foundation's fascist Project 2025 initiative. It is of no surprise, therefore, that when Kenton Skarin worked in the Governor Rauner administration, he engaged with The Heritage Foundation on their anti-Union efforts. In short, Clarance Thomas is the Judge who trained Kenton Skarin, a fact Skarin goes at great lengths to hide. Electing Skarin is effectively electing a protege of Thomas--someone who shares his values and judgment (or lack thereof). Illinois cannot afford a judge who has learned from, and written opinions for, a man so deeply corrupt. Lie by Omission #2: Skarin Misleads Voters About His Qualifications Another key misrepresentation in Skarin's campaign is his focus on bar poll scores--where he claims superiority over Judge Anderson. Skarin misleads voters, because bar poll scores are just one aspect of the Illinois State Bar Association's (ISBA) full rating system. These polls do not paint the full picture of a judge's qualifications. | | ---|---|--- Screen grab of Kenton Skarin's ad, falsely alleging he is a higher rated judge than John John Anderson. The covers 12 criteria, not just the three that Skarin cites. Accordingly, the ISBA gave Judge Anderson the highest possible rating: "Highly Recommended." Skarin, on the other hand, received only a "Recommended " rating from the ISBA. Below is what a full picture of the two judicial candidates actually looks like--once we remove Kenton Skarin's distorted view. | | ---|---|--- Accurate head to head comparison between Judge John Anderson and Kenton Skarin. In addition to the higher rating, Judge Anderson has nearly double the years of legal experience, four times the number of degrees, and the only judge on the ballot to have argued before the Illinois Supreme Court or have reported cases argued before the Illinois Appellate Court. It's clear why Skarin attempts to hide this from voters. Consider this: If Kenton Skarin refuses to acknowledge the full picture on something as straight forward as judicial qualifications between himself and his opponent, how can he be trusted to acknowledge the full picture when hearing complex cases that can make or break someone's life or livelihood? The answer is, he cannot be trusted. We would not accept that misleading behavior in a job interview, and it isn't behavior we should accept of a person seeking the prestigious office of appellate judge. In short, Judge Anderson's "Highly Recommended" rating speaks to his integrity, experience, and overall fitness for the role--qualities Skarin cannot match. Lie by Omission #3: Skarin Attacks Judge Anderson's Past While Hoping Voters Ignore His Own It would be one thing if Kenton Skarin critiqued Judge Anderson's rulings or record on the bench--but he doesn't. Instead, the only 'dirt' he can find on his opponent are traffic violations from literally the last century. If traffic tickets disqualify someone from being a judge, why is Skarin silent about Justice Thomas' dozens of ethics violations for taking bribes from billionaire Harlon Crow, among others? While Judge Anderson owns up to his past mistakes and shows a commitment to self-improvement, Skarin's omission of his deep ties to Thomas suggests a lack of transparency and accountability. Why does Skarin attack Judge Anderson's driving record? Because he knows Judge Anderson's record on the bench is stellar and unassailable, and the 'worst' thing about him is traffic infractions from his youth. If anything, this is an admission from Skarin about Judge Anderson's good judgment and good character, and voters should take note. | | ---|---|--- Meanwhile, Skarin's association with MAGA Justice Thomas should be a red flag for anyone concerned with ethics and judicial integrity. Skarin's campaign ad claims he puts 'fairness above politics'--yet he attacks Judge Anderson for his decades old driving record while ignoring his own mentor's decades of corruption currently destroying our republic. That's both unfair, and pure politics. In short, we need judges who recognize fairness is about your actions, not empty words, and Skarin does not pass that test. Conclusion: Illinois Deserves Judge John Anderson Kenton Skarin is scaring voters into voting for him. We must reject the fear mongering. Skarin's lies by omission--about his mentorship with Justice Clarence Thomas, his misleading focus on bar poll scores, and his meritless attacks on Judge Anderson--are individually disqualifying, and collectively mortifying. I hope you found value in this case study of how to properly evaluate judges before casting your ballot. Illinois cannot afford to place a protege of Clarence Thomas on the Appellate Court. The stakes are too high. We've seen the harm bad judges can do, and that's why we need to elect good judges like Judge John Anderson in Illinois, and around the country. | | ---|---|--- Why Your Support Matters:** Every dollar we spend is a vote for the kind of future we want. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7867%2E5257348%2EKokrNw ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek — During
a rambling speech at a campaign rally in Scranton, Pennsylvania, Donald
Trump attacked wind power, said he doesn’t care about being nice to women,
bragged about getting along well with North Korea’s dictator, Kim Jong Un,
and so much more for over 80 minutes.

And he came after me, too, in his latest unhinged attack.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241010_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=7867%2E5257348%2EKokrNw ]Before I get into the details of Trump’s latest attack, I’m hoping you
can pitch in to my campaign for Senate — because the last place Donald
Trump wants me to be is in the U.S. Senate, where I will hold him and his
enablers accountable every single day.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241010_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=7867%2E5257348%2EKokrNw ]Trump at a rally in Pennsylvania

“You take a child who is 5 years old, he knows more about Russia than my
son, and yet Adam Shifty Schiff came out of an Intelligence Committee
hearing and said ‘Donald Trump Jr. will go to jail for what he did with
Russia’... It was a scam!... He’s a sleazebag that goes out and says my son
will go to jail on a con job he made up with Hillary and some of the
others. How bad do you have to be?... But we’re going to defeat these
radical left lunatics.”

Derek,
there he goes again. Lie after lie. And the worst part is the former
president might actually believe them.

As chair of the House Intelligence Committee, I investigated Donald Trump
and revealed he (and Don Jr.) sought Russian help in his election,
received it, lied about it, and sought to cover it up.

Trump hopes his lies will be a distraction. His insults are meant to take
away from the truth — that Donald Trump and his campaign twice sought
foreign help to win the presidency.

And when he broke U.S. law by withholding critical aid to Ukraine to
extort their leader into helping his campaign, I led his impeachment and
secured the first bipartisan Senate vote to convict a U.S. president. He
has never let go of that humiliation, so he attacks me. Relentlessly.

He knows that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable
for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than
the reminder of how I stood up to him.

In the Senate, I’ll keep fighting his assaults on our democracy and hold
his biggest enablers accountable.

His obsession is the highest compliment — it means I’m doing my job.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em.0Y0BaT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20241010_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=7867%2E5257348%2EKokrNw ]I’ll always stand up to Trump and anyone who attacks our democracy. But
for us to respond before their vicious lies take hold, I need your
support. Please, I need you to pitch in. We have less than 4 weeks left to
defeat Trump and the MAGA movement.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

| | Friend, You know me—I’m never going to back a spending bill that makes things worse for the American people. Congress may not be throwing around huge spending packages right now, but we all know they’re coming, and the problem is still the same: wasteful spending jammed into bills that don’t address the real issues we face. Look at FEMA—they’re running out of funds, and instead of focusing on getting the states the resources they need, Washington is continuing with the same reckless approach.
---
[](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=77576aafb8ff49b795783de56eedd2e8&_e=ZUydHiX8QcELKRpeJOceIgzj8wRdRJ8iIKmCo2R4UvB7LiSIWwlIrlbf2RuFZx6aXbgkbv2zP3qJP3SnGEEb6mnkygE1gmjL4-I4QEi60xRRr6JTwxFsydzps6yIhmapkoEIXJtJ4kbmWMRUPksIzWqqPxoC8q4KDZQEMxFdpQu-niY-8_25qzXlFU-3OUduCksRalT-LcPHnUUFGcshRb3mjozKc39YeU9ZU3rc6a5vvqdcT8vVEplmKSJJN6FZTSke97lMlMR43h-e8h3ecNJT7wwQYN1OPK3MbsTSpnD_jQ8q6ftRRq5yRQiw_dvWcnM9ryMQJejhbJl6vPi13A%3D%3D)
---
| | This is why I’ve been pushing hard for single-issue spending bills. Why should we allow unrelated and unnecessary spending to piggyback on important funding? We need to handle each issue individually, with transparency and accountability. Friend, you have my word—I will never support a bill that adds more unnecessary debt on you, your family, and future generations. Washington needs to get its priorities straight. If we don’t right our wrongs, the same problems will keep happening, and the American people will keep paying the price. I’m fighting to make sure your tax dollars go where they’re needed—not where politicians want them to go. Thank you for standing with me as we demand better from Washington.
---
---
Tim Burchett

| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I'm writing to you today because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish our nation's guiding values of life, liberty, community, and faith.

Have you ever stopped to think about how charitable giving is a brilliant reflection of freedom?

It's a way for every American to use our hard-earned money to freely support the causes we care most about.

This is democracy in action: because every dollar you give is a vote for the future you want to see.

I'd like to personally invite you to join me in advancing common-sense solutions to our nation's toughest challenges by [making a generous gift of whatever your budget allows.](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=970f858ab16c4627b02a4fb97d30c5fc&_e=cjtl_9lr-tp9HyLnSq5W_Xsq4NDi1AeCr7wQcyqP-AbfOSveJ_YIo3U8ivPwoRoUYQBvAa0fPlRX8wejXXQJVzEyVrzuSAnLknjwl69QPUP2j_VIY0BH6HgXyxpq0iAbnqw-IKKa7UVF_tHCtkcd18aCDhX0a9qEN7MHZVpUTPHYsP2hSDuKW6En57pSJaksHRW85j2FgMRhPcmuQOb9PDZ19Ws2twgDz21vgaSLA0yaFRotUUzqiHOALPCmQnqIwzRC5o3TZfyVg2GJlhllZzFWqzLaP1jBkaQl2m8Y7TWeNi4ZKuEEqWa1ojcm0TifGPkJAcDHg8hTQbf78EcUggbfED4bh974F3NqWHdeIuGgTv5l0sa896eFnfAq_m6CkHqoHJSK6tZCk1MqCRDhLw%3D%3D)

Your investment will allow the American Cornerstone Institute to engage in independent research, grassroots outreach, and collaboration with conservative leaders to set forth a better path forward for our country, safeguarding freedom for you and your family in the coming years.

Will you join me? If so, you can support these efforts by clicking the link below:

[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/donate](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=970f858ab16c4627b02a4fb97d30c5fc&_e=cjtl_9lr-tp9HyLnSq5W_Xsq4NDi1AeCr7wQcyqP-AbfOSveJ_YIo3U8ivPwoRoUYQBvAa0fPlRX8wejXXQJVzEyVrzuSAnLknjwl69QPUP2j_VIY0BH6HgXyxpq0iAbnqw-IKKa7UVF_tHCtkcd18aCDhX0a9qEN7MHZVpUTPHYsP2hSDuKW6En57pSJaksHRW85j2FgMRhPcmuQOb9PDZ19Ws2twgDz21vgaSLA0yaFRotUUzqiHOALPCmQnqIwqBDxaZ-9y19-YsaOXEm_80YBrYfFQzPjR2A92Amg8OIdhzOVPIs59AdBeQeGHKvDGEfoF-dgzC_1uaeqB-F0z-kHUCfb1JfXyZ6i03cjS7gLKpDac0nftCRSVWdg2WCPOIeRCoCabEDMiMXZO3FLQ%3D%3D)

Where the Left wants bigger government, we'll fight for limited government and self-determination.

America is the greatest country that has ever existed. Please help me do everything possible to make sure it stays that way.

Thank you for your support, [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=970f858ab16c4627b02a4fb97d30c5fc&_e=cjtl_9lr-tp9HyLnSq5W_Xsq4NDi1AeCr7wQcyqP-AbfOSveJ_YIo3U8ivPwoRoUYQBvAa0fPlRX8wejXXQJVzEyVrzuSAnLknjwl69QPUP2j_VIY0BH6HgXyxpq0iAbnqw-IKKa7UVF_tHCtkcd18aCDhX0a9qEN7MHZVpUTPHYsP2hSDuKW6En57pSJaksHRW85j2FgMRhPcmuQOb9PDZ19Ws2twgDz21vgaSLA0yaFRotUUzqiHOALPCmQnqIz-0r9lrdUDAB99Cfto80pbDRLVZ_Lp_QtBwEKEmEyDy1D5KQA0IG_fKNEk_rsGbnLPknQFGOYYuhpBO15HL96M9qMfPQGqg1OzAIM3vJKUTmnPUowe4ptQPHjuu4OmCXOZFfgsKQKIzz2dzEaGlnDQ%3D%3D) Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

P.S. I know these are uncertain times. But no gift is too small. And every dollar you give today will have a long-term impact on restoring our nation's founding values. [Click here to give whatever you can today »](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=970f858ab16c4627b02a4fb97d30c5fc&_e=cjtl_9lr-tp9HyLnSq5W_Xsq4NDi1AeCr7wQcyqP-AbfOSveJ_YIo3U8ivPwoRoUYQBvAa0fPlRX8wejXXQJVzEyVrzuSAnLknjwl69QPUP2j_VIY0BH6HgXyxpq0iAbnqw-IKKa7UVF_tHCtkcd18aCDhX0a9qEN7MHZVpUTPHYsP2hSDuKW6En57pSJaksHRW85j2FgMRhPcmuQOb9PDZ19Ws2twgDz21vgaSLA0yaFRotUUzqiHOALPCmQnqIYrtklnTYgvKI4XmqfB_kNG8c639G2lEPLSH_VDc0AcsHoJCyujTHcWGhXBxxyRMsAk9ozTB5C1KtS4tQGonWJRTEsMzPnpVJWVynEVFXf-PJr36Xes_o6O0ILqkYdvlgyflN8Evxktp4f2WvV6v7VA%3D%3D)

# My View from inside an Election Game-Changer!
---
| [ ](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/ekcPJQPKp6VqHIeoXFK-SQ~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRo6qbMP0UgOWM2ZGQ3ZjM1MWJlY2M0MDU2M2EzZTBjM2JlNzBiYTdEK2h0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnlvdXR1YmUuY29tL3dhdGNoP3Y9dkZjX19fSHVYYmNXBXNwY2V1QgpnBswhCGefW30NUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABfYw~~)
---
| | Democrats Abroad - an arm of the DNC - is pretty angry with us right now! We launched an election game-changer, coordinated largely from Solomon Yue's kitchen table here in Salem, Oregon! _This was our Republicans Overseas (RO) October Surprise!_
I've served as senior advisor for RO for the past two years, but Solomon, RO co-founder, has worked for 10 years to bring the issue of double-taxation of overseas Americans to light. We gathered together our core team at RO (Kym, Jim, and then country chapter presidents...) and pitched the idea of a simple policy statement to the campaign. President Trump listened. Not only did he listen, but he fully understood the ramifications of this grossly unfair Biden/Harris policy on Americans.
Within 24 hours, President Trump himself gave us the greenlight to announce that he's adopting a policy supporting the END of double-taxation of overseas Americans!
We started with a press release, which I included in my last newsletter. We continued with Trump Campaign surrogate videos from people like Tulsi Gabbard, Rep. Byron Donalds and Dr. Ben Carson. (Those are below.)
Then President Trump gave us a written statement to release. The statement went to major media and BOOM. The _Wall Street Journal_ called and interviewed Solomon, and then the coverage spread like fire across the world. (Some examples below.)
We waited on pins and needles for President Trump's video. And when it came, he'd knocked it out of the ballpark!
9 million Americans live abroad and the tax proposal Kamala Harris has embraced can only be described as punitive. Many of those 9 million are voters. Many of those are registered in swing states where only 10K votes could make the difference. President Trump will win this election on this issue!
See why I'm so excited?! Everything you need to know is below. Share with your friends and family in the military or living abroad in another capacity - but please take the unsubscribe link off the bottom first so they don't accidentally unsub _you_!
PS - I'm sure it hasn't helped Democrats Abroad that every Democrat in their Israel office walked due to Biden/Harris policies that made them "feel targeted." That office folded.

clean_body: | | | | | My View from inside an Election Game-Changer! | ~~ | | Democrats Abroad - an arm of the DNC - is pretty angry with us right now! We launched an election game-changer, coordinated largely from Solomon Yue's kitchen table here in Salem, Oregon! This was our Republicans Overseas (RO) October Surprise! I've served as senior advisor for RO for the past two years, but Solomon, RO co-founder, has worked for 10 years to bring the issue of double-taxation of overseas Americans to light. We gathered together our core team at RO (Kym, Jim, and then country chapter presidents...) and pitched the idea of a simple policy statement to the campaign. President Trump listened. Not only did he listen, but he fully understood the ramifications of this grossly unfair Biden/Harris policy on Americans. Within 24 hours, President Trump himself gave us the greenlight to announce that he's adopting a policy supporting the END of double-taxation of overseas Americans! We started with a press release, which I included in my last newsletter. We continued with Trump Campaign surrogate videos from people like Tulsi Gabbard, Rep. Byron Donalds and Dr. Ben Carson. (Those are below.) Then President Trump gave us a written statement to release. The statement went to major media and BOOM. The Wall Street Journal called and interviewed Solomon, and then the coverage spread like fire across the world. (Some examples below.) We waited on pins and needles for President Trump's video. And when it came, he'd knocked it out of the ballpark! 9 million Americans live abroad and the tax proposal Kamala Harris has embraced can only be described as punitive. Many of those 9 million are voters. Many of those are registered in swing states where only 10K votes could make the difference. President Trump will win this election on this issue! See why I'm so excited?! Everything you need to know is below. Share with your friends and family in the military or living abroad in another capacity - but please take the unsubscribe link off the bottom first so they don't accidentally unsub you! PS - I'm sure it hasn't helped Democrats Abroad that every Democrat in their Israel office walked due to Biden/Harris policies that made them "feel targeted." That office folded. Peter, from the moment Donald Trump’s handpicked Supreme Court justices overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Republican extremists haven’t wasted a _moment_ attacking reproductive freedom.
The GOP already banned or severely limited abortion access in over a dozen states. That includes Texas, where the Supreme Court recently _denied_ a Biden administration appeal to allow some emergency abortion care in the state.
_And that’s exactly how the Trump campaign wants things to be._
In fact, J.D. Vance doubled down on his support for the status quo at last week’s vice presidential debate: “Let the individual states make their abortion policy.”
Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz’s response, on the other hand? **_“WE TRUST WOMEN.”_**
Look, you know the Harris campaign is fiercely committed to defending reproductive health care and ensuring that everyone in the country has access to safe and legal abortions — but we can't just sit back and hope for the best. **We need to defeat Donald Trump and his Project 2025 cronies if we want to protect Americans’ reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. Period.**

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 10th, 2024
body:
Florida has been hit by two massive hurricanes in under two weeks.
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to _Across the Country_ , our weekly series at No Dem Left Behind! We’re diving into the most pressing issues impacting the heartland of America as the 2024 election approaches. These are the stories that actually matter to our communities. Let’s stay informed, together. –Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **Florida**
---
|
---
Florida is getting hit by extreme hurricanes. Prior to Hurricane Milton, two other hurricanes shook Floridians earlier this year, leaving many stranded and financially overwhelmed. Tornadoes were reported across Florida resulting in 4 devastating casualties prior to Hurricane Milton. Destructive wind caused power outages for more than[ ](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v14mi-fdav0f-kyd76rh5/) [**3 million people**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v14mi-fdav0g-kyd76rh6/) in the state. [**Wind gusts of 100 mph**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2v14mi-fdav0h-kyd76rh7/) were recorded, so intense that makeshift shelters for first responders have collapsed. This category 3 storm impacted West Central Florida with 10 ft storms– with millions ordered to evacuate immediately. “Hurricane Helene, followed by Hurricane Milton, has shifted my perspective on the people most vulnerable, those who don’t have the privilege to evacuate amid all the chaos and devastation. As a Florida transplant, I can’t help but seriously worry for families and elderly folk who cannot leave the area. What Florida needs most right now is the utmost support and a solid recovery plan that will protect native residents and rebuild our communities,” says Imogene Dunn, a local Floridian. As communities were pulling together resources to combat the aftermath of Helene, Milton swiftly came in and left many feeling helpless. These back to back hurricanes mark a frightening reality that climate change is in full effect and has shown up in unprecedented ways. Our thoughts go out to all the families and communities who’ve been affected. NDLB believes it is time to put climate change and our vulnerable communities at the forefront of this election. We need leadership who admits to the harsh realities of this climate crisis and actively works to alleviate it. The Florida Senate Race has introduced two candidates with vastly different opinions on climate change. Republican candidate Rick Scott has banned the word "climate change” from state agencies as governor, whereas Democratic candidate Debbie Mucarsel-Powell, has proactively assembled plans for climate-resilient infrastructure. Florida Atlantic University reported that 90% of Floridians believe climate change is happening, with 68% of respondents calling on the state government to DO SOMETHING about it. NDLB supports this call to action, and we urge Floridians to do the same by using their 15th amendment right and VOTE this upcoming election cycle. **Join us next week with Sabrina for the latest updates on nationwide breaking news. Make sure to stay informed with NDLB!** **And if you would like to help with the hurricane relief efforts, click the button below.**

Fellow patriot,

We’re now inside the final month of this campaign.

We’re fighting for secure borders, affordable groceries and gas, safe neighborhoods, and a government that puts Americans FIRST again.

We can only achieve those things with a Republican House Majority, which will be won or lost here in NM-02 – **THE most competitive seat in the country.**

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ce50efc310024820a86bd537f7568ac2&_e=WAQbE-3olkU8eZhEbqE2h2K2kgbQM3_wztT8uUGocmxXJuk--YkzZozMnmvqB__n6vk7G8RrFjx6U6zmcDHyfOs3Cjz0f4kQAyok5-ev8DwfwD7Jl2jj5ofFmxClLQdtJBxal2ps9QlX1OqTqL1KOXdztfab5m746q98lgg5XbFvf1geTfwIsF5BKbjnRJsWnjnYx-8VIaYwa5zON5L2zhlQC28VQJ0vCcy1buDONq3i7uvXUWTm_bg19yzG5nTHCHzT76fnymJ7BARhx5Y-n5Y1vkP_GsU4nvHgHc5htM3iMVKAeaWAQOJ6pMk98ZhE4s4rGySqVUQzS6Q5RMFFTtUPfvfHy_BqmS11iwLcYnCarmEA43ku64DSB2LTYdOM-SNX_SzK5vTIYsWsMNkp7A%3D%3D)

This seat has flipped back and forth every cycle, and now it’s time to flip it back RED and keep it that way.

We’re neck-and-neck with pro-illegal immigration radical leftist Gabe Vasquez, and every dollar you give down the final stretch will be a difference-maker.

[**Whether you can give $5, $50, or $500, your support will help us reserve ad time, pay for our final mail pieces, ensure we have enough lawn signs, and travel across NM-02.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=ce50efc310024820a86bd537f7568ac2&_e=WAQbE-3olkU8eZhEbqE2h2K2kgbQM3_wztT8uUGocmxXJuk--YkzZozMnmvqB__n6vk7G8RrFjx6U6zmcDHyfOs3Cjz0f4kQAyok5-ev8DwfwD7Jl2jj5ofFmxClLQdtJBxal2ps9QlX1OqTqL1KOXdztfab5m746q98lgg5XbFvf1geTfwIsF5BKbjnRJsWnjnYx-8VIaYwa5zON5L2zhlQC28VQJ0vCcy1buDONq3Z3niCFBzfxcvnehgcW-xi2-MmT--UnTZ-qK7qJ3qkZNNYfIKNW9YzPIT-4b3mBBuDB3Jd9nuCQ0qQQhxOptkLR2h7uglE5NACoNdOhD7MLWked4JEmyQXBTuL9ozQSKHwe-UeI8BZoz8WQFycZCAi1C4cyZ9o4wA2TnTFRw-3Rw%3D%3D)

Help us protect the House and put America First again!

Yvette Herrell

subject: “Secret sauce”

I’m used to being written off,
Peter.

When I first ran for Congress, no one thought I could win. Despite the
naysayers, I ended up winning that race and became the very first woman
elected to the House of Representatives from Wisconsin. And it wouldn’t be
the last time our team would make history.

When I ran for U.S. Senate in 2012, an incredible team of grassroots
supporters (like you!) fought alongside me — even as some people wrote us
off. You helped me become the first woman elected to the Senate from our
state and the first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history.

When you defy the odds as much as I have, people start to ask: what’s your
secret?

I hate to burst their bubble, but the truth is, there’s no “secret sauce.”

My “secret” is showing up all over the state. It’s listening to people.
Hearing their concerns. Then taking those concerns back to inform my work
in Washington.

It’s what separates me from my right-wing opponent who’s trying to buy
this Senate seat — a California megamillionaire who doesn’t know the first
thing about what Wisconsinites need.

Eric Hovde has a long history of disparaging the communities he’s seeking
to represent — from saying farmers are lazy to claiming people in nursing
homes shouldn’t vote, and a whole lot more...

But what he lacks in experience and understanding, he makes up for with a
personal fortune that’s self-funding his campaign to flip Wisconsin red.
He and his Republican allies have already plastered Wisconsin with $63
million worth of ads to effectively close the polling gap and make this a
toss up race.

While I continue to connect with voters in every corner of the Badger
state, I could really use your support to make sure my campaign has the
resources to fight back against the Republicans who are currently
outspending us on the airwaves.

humbly asking: Will you make a donation today to help defend my Senate

He was fired for it! **AVERAGE JOE** tells his unwavering true story of faith, strength, and courage.

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values.

After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty_?**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a279b73ecafb44e8ab1c761fcd7e7554&_e=uJSh9zY6J67hkZ5jrl5b_ttEZ_l1-LIx3FYKCBEZj7iNh03MBUfexycfgnqecAFkR64hklpuepItb2zSrHCAHBll8jgQx6AUahvOz6esSq96GzF-aXZLyW5FZMHlQUQqNJBTdzmb-WwZ-xOK9dYqB1mqzzIw9g31feLq497PjcL_UzwNCgGppMyxnKSqQXCRtFozoeQplR1ZOhiEBhmz5BzdprOLXqXXmGJZcJydxnQ6NowT3ilAJcMhDjtJC2SLEwccS-zoLAi-Ju8qDYBNePK8GtS6uDgdqLfJRDB-4bF0K5atYlKhIZNnEr1xSWF_JUohygp7fO3v6vJr6RajzSqbgFJxw6xjGpL-yTP1IJBtkdmqzfFyqGwQ_SQXyYOzLF204zgQHsu08KGX_rzy7rWOgboIKFfPYvDjOhDeic8BcSLTtsJIUnN_wjUNft1b) [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a279b73ecafb44e8ab1c761fcd7e7554&_e=uJSh9zY6J67hkZ5jrl5b_ttEZ_l1-LIx3FYKCBEZj7iNh03MBUfexycfgnqecAFkR64hklpuepItb2zSrHCAHBll8jgQx6AUahvOz6esSq96GzF-aXZLyW5FZMHlQUQqNJBTdzmb-WwZ-xOK9dYqB1mqzzIw9g31feLq497PjcL_UzwNCgGppMyxnKSqQXCRtFozoeQplR1ZOhiEBhmz5BzdprOLXqXXmGJZcJydxnQ6NowT3ilAJcMhDjtJC2SLEwccS-zoLAi-Ju8qDYBNeBZEAsy1JsggCwGDkaiE8SWu0ScWycE3YXPZyEPYPacrEtE-wJuEDAngYTbTe4os2k3JOGDiG3E4mnBa0J5IgG7pacfhmcE9TiZYxEoEPj2XvQdYGjARXn9DitS7bqrgRxiY0Hs7PMxr4vEU_M25UQFd3d3-VXb11Aq1eQ-8V9li) In addition to the passing of the Respect for Marriage Act, numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the Respect for Marriage Act, brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values.**

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values,**are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

name: Jill Stein for President
subject: Important ballot access update: Ohio
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
OH Secretary of State continues shenanigans

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, We have an update on Ohio. If you haven’t heard, someone not authorized to submit paperwork on behalf of the campaign turned in a document requesting to withdraw the Vice Presidential candidate from the ballot, after the deadline to submit a new candidate. The person who submitted this paperwork to the Ohio Secretary of State admitted when turning in the form that the signature on the form was not “wet” (it was a graphic that was copy and pasted), and that they were not a campaign staffer. The Secretary of State should have rejected it on those grounds alone. But instead, they accepted the form - then declared no votes for Jill would count. To make this even more incredible and unacceptable, our Ohio VP candidate then sent the SoS a notarized affidavit stating that she didn’t authorize the withdrawal form, and the SoS replied that they wouldn’t accept it because the notarization wasn’t “embossed”... after they had accepted the original, unauthorized VP withdrawal form with a copy-pasted signature. We have filed a lawsuit to make the Ohio Secretary of State correct their error. **_We are confident that we will win the lawsuit and votes for Jill will be counted in Ohio._** These fights against shenanigans in multiple states have been a huge expense for the campaign, but it is worth it to ensure that the people, including the 8 million registered voters in Ohio, have an anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action candidate on their ballots in November.

**" IRS extends tax deadline for residents hit by Hurricane Beryl,"** Houston Chronicle's **Shakari Briggs** -- "Following [Hurricane Beryl's devastation](https://substack.com/redirect/96d005e8-cdbf-495f-a681-c33b89917480?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across Texas, some taxpayers now have until Feb. 3, 2025, to file individual and business tax returns and make tax payments. The Internal Revenue Service announced the deadline extension for affected residents and businesses in 67 counties.

The counties included in the disaster declaration issued by the Federal Emergency Management Agency include Anderson, Angelina, Aransas, Austin, Bowie, Brazoria, Brazos, Burleson Calhoun, Cameron, Camp, Cass, Chambers, Cherokee, Colorado, Dewitt, Fayette, Fort Bend, Freestone, Galveston, Goliad, Gregg, Grimes, Hardin, Harris, Harrison, Hidalgo, Houston, Jackson, Jasper, Jefferson, Kenedy, Kleberg, Lavaca, Lee, Leon, Liberty, Madison, Marion, Matagorda, Milam, Montgomery, Morris, Nacogdoches, Newton, Nueces, Orange, Panola, Polk, Refugio, Robertson, Rusk, Sabine, San Augustine, San Jacinto, San Patricio, Shelby, Trinity, Tyler, Upshur, Victoria, Walker, Waller, Washington, Webb, Wharton and Willacy counties.

According to the IRS, residents and businesses who are eligible for the Feb. 3, 2025 filing deadline are:

**" Dallas responds to suburban push to contribute less money to DART,"** Dallas Morning News' **Everton Bailey, Jr.** -- "Dallas Area Rapid Transit's largest member says it won't support stripping any money away from the regional agency during the 2025 Texas legislative session despite [nearly half of the other cities pushing to cut their sales tax contributions](https://substack.com/redirect/69a2be57-27b5-4d1d-a936-96245bc0477a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

When approving a series of legislative priorities, the Dallas City Council on Tuesday agreed to advocate for tax collections from DART's 13 service cities to remain the same. [City officials from around North Texas are arguing their residents don't have enough bus and rail service](https://substack.com/redirect/99b661f6-b526-4499-b457-8f17f6ab6fca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to justify the agency getting taxpayer funding at the same rate. The cities contributed [around $870 million in combined sales tax revenue in the most recent fiscal year](https://substack.com/redirect/8505f019-8863-4895-aa6e-5e3f0fc850fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that ended on Sept. 30, with around half coming from Dallas. DART estimates getting around $910 million this fiscal year.

The DART Board [approved a $1.8 billion budget](https://substack.com/redirect/3b03ebf0-4dec-4661-b508-cc93cb480fe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sept. 26. Other sources of revenue include fares and federal funding.

As of Monday, two Dallas City Council committees backed opposing recommendations on DART funding. The council's transportation and infrastructure committee supported fully funding DART, and the council's government performance and financial management committee supported restructuring DART sales tax contributions.

However, concerns over the effect of a lower rate on Dallas' residents most dependent on public transit led most city leaders to get behind supporting DART.

"We're talking about people and transportation," said council member **Carolyn King Arnold**. "This is a non-negotiable conversation." She added that she believes the "city and this region depends on DART as a viable means of transportation."" **" IRS extends tax deadline for residents hit by Hurricane Beryl,"** Houston Chronicle's **Shakari Briggs** -- "Following [Hurricane Beryl's devastation](https://substack.com/redirect/ed859bb6-ba98-4c56-8857-012bf04f8169?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across Texas, some taxpayers now have until Feb. 3, 2025, to file individual and business tax returns and make tax payments. The Internal Revenue Service announced the deadline extension for affected residents and businesses in 67 counties.

The counties included in the disaster declaration issued by the Federal Emergency Management Agency include Anderson, Angelina, Aransas, Austin, Bowie, Brazoria, Brazos, Burleson Calhoun, Cameron, Camp, Cass, Chambers, Cherokee, Colorado, Dewitt, Fayette, Fort Bend, Freestone, Galveston, Goliad, Gregg, Grimes, Hardin, Harris, Harrison, Hidalgo, Houston, Jackson, Jasper, Jefferson, Kenedy, Kleberg, Lavaca, Lee, Leon, Liberty, Madison, Marion, Matagorda, Milam, Montgomery, Morris, Nacogdoches, Newton, Nueces, Orange, Panola, Polk, Refugio, Robertson, Rusk, Sabine, San Augustine, San Jacinto, San Patricio, Shelby, Trinity, Tyler, Upshur, Victoria, Walker, Waller, Washington, Webb, Wharton and Willacy counties.

> Businesses with an original or extended due date including, among others, calendar-year partnerships and S corporations whose 2023 extensions run out on Sept. 16, 2024, and calendar-year corporations whose 2023 extensions run out on Oct. 15, 2024

For more information, visit [IRS.com](https://substack.com/redirect/3014ea3f-36b2-4250-8d5f-f546bbe04c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." **" Dallas responds to suburban push to contribute less money to DART,"** Dallas Morning News' **Everton Bailey, Jr.** -- "Dallas Area Rapid Transit's largest member says it won't support stripping any money away from the regional agency during the 2025 Texas legislative session despite [nearly half of the other cities pushing to cut their sales tax contributions](https://substack.com/redirect/d8fc39b1-1762-46d8-879d-e478ed0df9d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

When approving a series of legislative priorities, the Dallas City Council on Tuesday agreed to advocate for tax collections from DART's 13 service cities to remain the same. [City officials from around North Texas are arguing their residents don't have enough bus and rail service](https://substack.com/redirect/5861791b-a6c5-49fd-8e5c-c0a4a814e13f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to justify the agency getting taxpayer funding at the same rate. The cities contributed [around $870 million in combined sales tax revenue in the most recent fiscal year](https://substack.com/redirect/da693d3c-f10a-4b8c-be09-4c7c6f6a43db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that ended on Sept. 30, with around half coming from Dallas. DART estimates getting around $910 million this fiscal year.

The DART Board [approved a $1.8 billion budget](https://substack.com/redirect/f6f6abaa-8cb9-4cac-bb84-cb8167f531c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Sept. 26. Other sources of revenue include fares and federal funding.

As of Monday, two Dallas City Council committees backed opposing recommendations on DART funding. The council's transportation and infrastructure committee supported fully funding DART, and the council's government performance and financial management committee supported restructuring DART sales tax contributions.

However, concerns over the effect of a lower rate on Dallas' residents most dependent on public transit led most city leaders to get behind supporting DART.

"We're talking about people and transportation," said council member **Carolyn King Arnold**. "This is a non-negotiable conversation." She added that she believes the "city and this region depends on DART as a viable means of transportation."" Here's a way to keep yourself protected and illuminate your path on night walks.

We made a stun tool that harnesses the absolute maximum voltage we were allowed to put into one civilian-approved product.

Introducing the 250 MILLION VOLT Stun Baton and Flashlight, we call it [**THE MUTILATOR**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18757/6374453/b06bf9fee8d6d744a6836abc046f440c0cb5b899/4cdc3ca63536fbb8e4c1a8525e2e3ade679cb645).

**We certainly hope you never encounter a situation where you will need to use this on another person...

...although if you're on a night walk, and you sense a threat coming in the distance, let the thunderous CRACK of The Mutilator send a message for those within ear shot to be very cautious when approaching. **

This is not a toy, or a gimmicky product that will only produce a sound of 250 million volts, IT IS A **[ELECTROCUTION SELF-DEFENSE WEAPON](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18757/6374453/b06bf9fee8d6d744a6836abc046f440c0cb5b899/4cdc3ca63536fbb8e4c1a8525e2e3ade679cb645)** and will absolutely take an attacker down.

We can probably both agree you'll want to carry your concealed firearm for ultimate protection, but most of us aren't going to walk around the neighborhood holding your firearm open carry every single time you leave the house to walk the dog (even if your state permits).

Carrying the mutilator, acts as a, essential high-lumen flashlight, but has that next level of convenient electrocution threat defense at a moment's notice.

Today we are are running a special discount that comes with an industry leading lifetime warranty.

Not much to lose, but 250M volts of defense to gain with this one.

The U.S. Senate race that has been overlooked for months is now drawing everyone's attention. Conservative businessman Eric Hovde is poised to defeat ultra-liberal incumbent Senator Tammy Baldwin. Hovde was down by 7 points most of the summer but has surged and now only trails by 2 points. The left-leaning Cook Political Report was forced to move the race from "Lean D" to "Toss-Up" after their own survey showed Hovde's surge. _"While Baldwin is still leading independents by eight points, 50%-42%, we have seen an 11-point swing among the bloc toward Hovde since August,"_ Cook reported.

[**Conservatives can win this race, but we must flood Eric Hovde's campaign with contributions right now.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=40383b30a91b4380834faab15b0513ef&_e=W0XkFwTycT_1vzsGbKO5Uaz8jXdjIzEgy_a6fO21eI7LKDpti2w17frTWUIQ2StjDyrr21wPXm7Deii2jxMZyzggKv-D8FUsRNFIblvqmv6v3TQhn6sWeh4HZ43rx8do571YY60UxE3pw5lP1BubWlQPSchNiPtaUrg1LFTl7rquA0ryPhk0oUekl-KCUMTqEpJndjthJx9Y3NAP-KmzvyF5zWweRbBOmdER3zrD1QeYG6JSFY_IMkUt5LAZaAbo) For the final weeks of this race, Republicans have _spent more_ on TV ads than the Democrats, but the Democrats have actually _bought more_ ads. Peter, As Florida braces for its second major hurricane in the span of weeks, and North Carolina is just beginning to rebuild — **we can no longer deny the consequences of climate change.** The consistent onslaught of natural disasters we are facing is a blazing indicator of what’s to come. Climate change is an imminent threat to our planet, our home, and our future. If we fail to pass legislation that protects our planet, we will continue to suffer. We must do everything we can to preserve and restore our climate — for us, for our children, for future generations. **There is no _“Planet B,”_ Peter.** [I refuse to stand by as our neighbors face another tragedy. I refuse to stand by as our nation fails to address the reality of the climate crisis. I'm at my wits' end, Friend.

| | | Peter, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a major initiative this week that would expand Medicare to cover long-term home health care for seniors and people with disabilities.1 Her proposal will allow seniors to retire with dignity, and provide people with disabilities with the care they need, while being able to remain in the comfort of their own homes. And it will allow caregiving family members to remain in the workforce. **These are the exact kinds of policies we need to support working families across the country struggling with the overwhelming cost of care.** **[Add your name here to say you support Kamala Harris’ plan to expand Medicare to cover long-term home health care. Then, share your story on how this policy will impact you and your family.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIewuyjyAfuswR9y9SJ-tpL4OgV-OqB4veUWIwnK4DHCom6TXny_97T5wNmuC_PPchXhHODzrg6AXhySnoE_5VTb8fa0qB5ZtRkAdHUUI-XHY5A1T5GCwr3Aey-gQOvcOP7NlRxqfXMKdNVqPzEGtXZJK-07a9FF_sRSccGG9eTgX6KPIRuR8FN0nsuLAp0QpMiG6T_8BvSA4O94uX5Y-ESuoLemByAk-8cmkfq0SOS8K_-toCqtKUfx4yg7mt0YZ5XkrMy435mqwYNsp-0FvSHRi9V_G9cAvits5hRokrmotzmmODGaumh1vIzMOoKOntGzPj8qA5rJDE4nFOX-7jv/4ah/zNj6J5RMQ2e8ULx7DWDb8A/h0/h001.up_WLqTnIeae9uIH9bgr0UZmd_XEsw1I97WG0bfJxP0)** **[ADD YOUR NAME](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoe1DuqQbjt4KoloTZxD-XRIewuyjyAfuswR9y9SJ-tpL4OgV-OqB4veUWIwnK4DHCom6TXny_97T5wNmuC_PPchXhHODzrg6AXhySnoE_5VTb8fa0qB5ZtRkAdHUUI-XHY5A1T5GCwr3Aey-gQOvcOPsptunskHA4wtVQ5pvrZdfzY1BEUVIOMCxH-eMiU8W0-yLZXezA-nS4oJvUIs4sR80bWORfzFXusucwVPIZ8Z8UCm6BlfQ0UgebqEu2TxBOw0VdsWFzmbihUYbJiUeTgBU4qJ01pEkzf4Zi24VLtjY5cwR-nPJcug4CIB3vskqcoZysi6EEvi9Z3jKsQlKJJafaZqgqsDR4glpfpTK6X47/4ah/zNj6J5RMQ2e8ULx7DWDb8A/h1/h001.1hbq9nkkL2AgPEfWVVMTlCOJ7mEQVTfIhboPkVnnXBc)** Millions of working families struggle to afford the astronomical costs of caregiving for their loved ones — which can often cost up to six figures a year.2 But Medicaid only covers in-home healthcare in rare circumstances. This forces many working age caregivers to either leave the workforce entirely, in order to take care of their loved ones, or put their family members in nursing homes or long-term care facilities, even if those loved ones would be better served at home. It also places an extra burden on nursing homes and assisted living facilities — 57% of which have waitlists and 46% are already starting to limit new admissions.3 Nearly 20% of seniors need help with daily activities like bathing, dressing, and feeding, and that percentage grows the older they get. And with 30 million baby boomers expected to reach retirement age in the next 5 years, we could soon face a caregiving crisis, unless we figure out a solution soon.4 **Kamala Harris’ plan to have Medicare cover in-home health care will give families the flexibility to make caregiving decisions that best work for their families, while giving seniors and people with disabilities independence and dignity.** **[Will you sign on to our petition in support of Kamala Harris’ in-home health care plan? clean_body: | | | Peter, Vice President Kamala Harris announced a major initiative this week that would expand Medicare to cover long-term home health care for seniors and people with disabilities.1 Her proposal will allow seniors to retire with dignity, and provide people with disabilities with the care they need, while being able to remain in the comfort of their own homes. And it will allow caregiving family members to remain in the workforce. These are the exact kinds of policies we need to support working families across the country struggling with the overwhelming cost of care. Millions of working families struggle to afford the astronomical costs of caregiving for their loved ones — which can often cost up to six figures a year.2 But Medicaid only covers in-home healthcare in rare circumstances. This forces many working age caregivers to either leave the workforce entirely, in order to take care of their loved ones, or put their family members in nursing homes or long-term care facilities, even if those loved ones would be better served at home. It also places an extra burden on nursing homes and assisted living facilities — 57% of which have waitlists and 46% are already starting to limit new admissions.3 Nearly 20% of seniors need help with daily activities like bathing, dressing, and feeding, and that percentage grows the older they get. And with 30 million baby boomers expected to reach retirement age in the next 5 years, we could soon face a caregiving crisis, unless we figure out a solution soon.4 Kamala Harris’ plan to have Medicare cover in-home health care will give families the flexibility to make caregiving decisions that best work for their families, while giving seniors and people with disabilities independence and dignity. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Huffpost, October 8, 2024 2\. , A Place For Mom, July 31, 2024 3\. , American Health Care Association / National Center for Assisted Living, August 22, 2024 4\. , Yahoo Finance, May 2, 2024 Thoughts? | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

NEWS: Lawson-Remer Responds To Faulconer's Call To Clean Up The River As Homeless Encampments Grow And Trash Flows Into Our Waterways | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a1164fd630cf/news-lawson-remer-responds-to-faulconers-call-to-clean-up-the-river-as-homeless-encampments-grow-and-trash-flows-into-our-waterways?e=784f78234b)

| |
---
| | |
# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 10, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Lawson-Remer Responds To Faulconer's Call To Clean Up The River As Homeless Encampments Grow And Trash Flows Into Our Waterways**
_Lawson-Remer Continues To Show No Urgency As Environmental And Human Tragedy Gets Worse_
San Diego, CA – With just weeks until the election, Terra Lawson-Remer is scrambling to appear like she's finally addressing the homeless crisis – after three years in office –announcing an update on what she’s doing. But this too-little, too-late update comes after years of inaction as the vice chair of the San Diego Regional Task Force on Homelessness Continuum of Care Board where she failed to attend a single meeting in the last three years. Voters shouldn't be fooled by her election-year stunt.
_**"Terra Lawson-Remer has proven she's not serious about solving the homeless crisis. For three years, she's been absent—literally and figuratively—from doing the hard work needed to address homelessness," said Faulconer. "This last-minute update reeks of election-year desperation. San Diego deserves a leader who shows up and delivers results, not someone who ignores the problem until it's politically convenient. Voters deserve a leader who will take immediate action, not someone who suddenly decides to care when her job is on the line. I've done the hard work before, and I'll do it again as County Supervisor," Faulconer continued. "From day one, I will clear encampments, clean up our streets, and move people into the safety of shelters where they can receive the help they need to turn their lives around."**_
---
[](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=0dd9dbdec2&e=784f78234b)
| [_**WATCH KEVIN FAULCONER CONTINUE TO HIGHLIGHT THE PROBLEMS AT THE RIVER TERRA LAWSON-REMER CONTINUES TO IGNORE**_](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=e3c0cd3a99&e=784f78234b)
---
| As mayor of San Diego, Faulconer successfully tackled homelessness by working across the aisle, building partnerships, and taking real action—something Lawson-Remer is now trying to copy just weeks before voters head to the polls. Faulconer prioritized clearing encampments, moving individuals into shelters, and providing critical mental health resources during his tenure. He led by example and delivered real results, unlike Lawson-Remer, whose inaction has only exacerbated the crisis.
Lawson-Remer is scrambling for solutions, borrowing from Faulconer's successful playbook because her record of absenteeism and inaction can't be defended. San Diego deserves better. It's time for leadership that will take real, consistent action—starting from day one.
_Kevin Faulconer was known for his pragmatic, results-driven approach to solving homelessness, boosting the local economy, and improving public safety. His successful two terms as mayor were marked by bipartisan cooperation and a focus on getting things done, not just making promises. As mayor, he met monthly with the San Diego River Park Foundation. He worked to keep the river clean, preventing the current environmental and human catastrophe Lawson-Remer has allowed all these years. Faulconer is committed to bringing that same leadership and work ethic to the San Diego County Board of Supervisors._
For more information about Kevin Faulconer’s campaign for Supervisor and proactive approach to the homeless crisis we’re facing, please visit www.kevinfaulconer.com

subject: About the SCOTUS ruling on emergency abortions in Texas
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
You have probably seen by now that, this week, the United States Supreme Court declined to hear an appeal of a ruling from the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals that the federal government cannot require hospitals to provide abortion care in emergency rooms in Texas when women in the state need it.
secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2410scotus?refcode=lpfe2410scotus [secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2410scotus?refcode=lpfe2410scotus]
This ruling not only undermines our access to reproductive health care, it undermines the ability of the federal government to protect all of our rights. For us in Texas, it means emergency rooms can continue to turn away pregnant women experiencing life-threatening medical complications, denying them the care they so desperately need. This ruling ensures the chaos and cruelty we have been experiencing in Texas will continue, offering no reassurances to doctors who could face penalties—including jail time—for performing abortions for patients in dire circumstances. More women will die as a result.
This is another reminder that we cannot count on the courts—not the Texas Supreme Court or the U.S. Supreme Court—to protect us. We must elect leaders at every level of government who care about the health of women in Texas and across the country and who will do everything they can to protect us and our rights.
And we have less than a month left to do all we can to ensure real leaders win their races, especially Vice President Kamala Harris—who will appoint future justices to the Supreme Court and the Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals that issued this terrible ruling in the first place—and Colin Allred, who as our Senator will confirm them. #TeamLizzie is on the job. We understand the assignment. And we are doing all we can for the next 25 days to deliver.
Defending our freedom requires all of us to get involved. As a dedicated member of our team, I know I can count on you to be a part of our fight—from now through Election Day and beyond.
Together, we can do anything,

subject: $7.25 an hour is a poverty wage.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
This coming January, the minimum wage in Washington will increase to $16.66 an hour.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241010-4384-footer&t=1&akid=4384%2E420207%2EQQP3-u)
Peter,
This coming January, the minimum wage in Washington will increase to $16.66 an hour. That’s because our state law requires the minimum wage to increase each year along with the cost of living — _**which really should be the case everywhere!**_
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241010?refcode=em20241010&amount=3&refcode2=4384_420207_QQP3-u&akid=4384%2E420207%2EQQP3-u)
[**Will you pitch in $3 to help our movement win in November so we can follow Washington’s lead on the federal level?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241010?refcode=em20241010&amount=3&refcode2=4384_420207_QQP3-u&akid=4384%2E420207%2EQQP3-u)
While Washington has modernized its minimum wage laws, there are still far too many places that haven’t. **In some states, the minimum wage remains $7.25 an hour. That’s literally a poverty-level wage.**
All people deserve to earn a decent living, whether you’re a CEO or a customer service rep. All work has dignity, and no one who works 40+ hours a week should find themselves struggling to afford the basics like rent, groceries, and medical expenses.
Pramila’s fighting hard to raise the federal minimum wage in Congress. But as long as Mike Johnson or any of his MAGA colleagues is serving as Speaker, those proposals are dead on arrival.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

I'm not a politician by trade, but I'm a patriot by heart. And that's why I'm writing to you today, with a sense of urgency and a call to action.

As a proud Navy Veteran, Navy Wife, Navy Mom, and Nurse Practitioner, I've dedicated my life to serving this great nation and protecting its people.

But I've had enough of the empty promises and failed leadership in Washington. That's why I took a stand and ran for office - to fight for the values and freedoms that we hold dear.

And I'm not just fighting for a seat in Congress, I'm fighting for the future of our country. The Democrats know it, and that's why they're pulling out all the stops to take me down.

I'm one of their top targets, and millions of dollars are being poured into defeating me. _**But I won't back down. **_

I won't back down because I know that I'm fighting for something bigger than myself. I'm fighting for the rights and freedoms of the American people.

But I need your help. I’m running for Congress to fight for YOU because Granite Staters deserve a leader who is dedicated to protecting our fundamental freedoms, defending our democracy, and lowering costs for hard-working families!

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94755587/504428810/478451526?refcode=BLU_EM_GOOD_2024-10-10_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTMwMjAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2M4N2Y4NmEtNTE4Ny1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AX6aN9yWxENDvI9GL96dGK5F2s2NjkWUpOqN2QEfLxI=)

| Peter,

One of the most important lessons I learned while serving in the Navy is how to work with people who you may not see eye to eye with.

In politics, we may not agree on everything, but we find common ground and get the job done because that is what it takes to deliver for our community. I’ve carried this lesson with me throughout my life, and I’ll bring that same type of common-sense leadership with me to Congress.

The rise of right-wing extremism and the divisive politics ushered in by Donald Trump has stifled all of our progress and brought Congress to a standstill. I know that if we come together – _even when we don’t agree_ – we can still make meaningful progress for Granite Staters.

**I’m running for Congress to fight for YOU because Granite Staters deserve a leader who is dedicated to protecting our fundamental freedoms, defending our democracy, and lowering costs for hard-working families!**

Through cooperation, we can achieve meaningful results that help improve the lives of ALL Granite Staters. name: Neil Parrott
subject: Mark Your Calendars!
body:
Events this weekend and next week...could you join me in-person or virtually? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=d25edac07d)
---
|
---
| | Peter, do you have plans for the weekend?

If you can get to Garrett County this weekend, you are in for a treat.

The Autumn Glory Parade is one of the highlights of our year! My wife April loves this parade. The parade floats are impressive and unique, and we love Western Maryland in the fall! The weather is supposed to be perfect.

The parade begins Saturday, October 12, at 1pm in downtown Oakland, MD. Look for us in the green shirts!

After the parade, from 2-4pm, I would love to have the chance to talk with you at the home of Buzz & Fannie Johnson in Oakland. This is a free meet-and-greet! Talk with me about your community. How can we work together? I'd love to hear your thoughts. Let us know if you need the address!

From 7 to 9pm at night, please join us for Free Ice Cream and Hot Chocolate, at the Corn Maze on 596 Griffith Rd, in Accident, MD!

The corn maze theme this year is perfect : "Farmers, the Heart of America." Farmers enter the maze free during this event! We will be there from 7-9pm, hoping to talk with everyone about education, rural broadband, and the farming community! |

---

---

---
|
---
|
Above, our friend, the parrot Bert, greets young guests at the 2022 Autumn Glory Parade! **Bert was an intelligent, gentle bird.** He has since passed, and this year we will be walking in his memory.

Will you help me over the next few weeks?
* Talk to your family, friends, and neighbors. Ask them to make sure that they vote!
* Wear your green Parrott T Shirt everywhere you go!
* Could you hold a sign, smile, and wave at cars? Email us, and we'll get you started!
* Put out a Parrott yard sign, and look for places in your community where we could place a sign!
* Vote early! If you can vote by mail, do it. You never know what will be happening in your world on Election Day. Early Voting begins in Maryland on October 24.
* If you can chip in some money, we sure could use it. Commercials are expensive and help us to communicate with voters and to encourage people to vote!

---
| I am an engineer, a small business owner, and a father of 3. I have invested in my community, and I love our country. I live right in the middle of District 6. I'm running to represent my friends and neighbors.

Our country has some SERIOUS problems caused by the Biden Administration and DC-Insiders like Nancy Pelosi... and my opponent.

I've been solving problems with practical solutions for decades. It's time to get to work for some real results to help hard-working Americans. Thank you for your support, and I look forward to talking with you soon.

For our country,
Neil

---

clean_body: | | | Hey Peter, Scout here. I know a few tricks, but I'm new to this email thing. I'm writing today to tell you more about me and my family, and to ask you to support Tim's campaign for Vice President. Let me explain: I wasn't always Scout. When I first met the Walzes, I was going by "Gene," the name Midwest Animal Rescue and Services gave me. Back then, I wasn't sure if people were good. They made me pretty nervous. My littermates and I were left in a box in Oklahoma to fend for ourselves at 11 weeks old. But then everything changed. Tim and the family picked me up and started calling me Scout. I think this name fits me much better. This family fits me much better too. The Walzes taught me how to live and love. They're a family of teachers, after all. I learned how to play frisbee when Tim throws it. I learned how to order a pup cup on summer drives to the local Dairy Queen. I learned how to accept those different from me, like my cat sister Honey (I even learned how to steal food from her bowl). Because of Tim, I know people are good. As governor, he's signed legislation enacting paid family and medical leave, investing in public safety, and providing universal free school meals. As a food-motivated voter, that is very important to me. Good people deserve good government. That's what this campaign is all about. Tim talks a lot about the importance of grassroots support. So I dug up some roots in the grass, but I didn't find any out there. I'm hoping you can help me out. He says it comes from people like you chipping in $5, $25, even $50 at a time! Peter, we have to band together to defeat Trump (who does not have a dog, I might add). Kamala and Tim are fighting for the people -- and the canines. Trump is fighting for himself. That's like hogging all the treats and asking for more. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | That's enough writing for me today. Lots of naps to take and food to steal. Hopefully, I get some peanut butter for writing this one. Woof, Scout Scout Walz First Dog of Minnesota | | | |

We need a strong turnout this election, and everyone has to play their part. | = = = If you’re going to vote early, do you know when early voting starts in your state? Voting by mail? Maybe you need to know when and where to drop off your ballot? Or are you waiting until Election Day — and need to know how late polling locations will be open? We know voters across the country will have lots of other questions about how and where to vote. It’s your support that helps us turn out voters and get them the information they need to cast their ballots. = = When we have access to tools that can help voters navigate casting their vote, we can fight back against voter suppression and disinformation, creating a democracy that includes all of us. Thanks for helping us spread the word about voting! Fair Fight Action = | * 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2024 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved. Emails like this one are the best way to communicate updates with voting rights activists like you. Thank you for being in the fight to ensure access to democracy for all. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

name: Emergency Response @ USO
subject: Hurricane Milton Update:
body:
In times of crisis, your support is more important than ever.
[](https://www.uso.org)
[GIVE NOW](https://links.e.uso.)
---
**BREAKING: Thousands of National Guard and active duty service members responding to Hurricane Milton need our support.** [**Will you rush an emergency donation of $29 or more to support our heroes around the world at this critical moment?***](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Last night, Hurricane Milton struck Florida as a Category 3 storm, bringing with it a massive storm surge, catastrophic tornadoes and devastating flooding.
While the worst of the damage is still being assessed and this is a rapidly developing situation, we know many of the affected communities were still recovering from Hurricane Helene less than two weeks ago, making this storm's impact even worse.
Thousands of National Guard members are still working to help communities recover from Hurricane Helene. Now, thousands more are being deployed to Florida from all over the country to conduct search and rescue missions, clear debris and provide lifesaving aid to communities in urgent need.
[**In times of increased need, the USO 's work to support and uplift service members is more important than ever -- but to scale up our work in moments of crisis, we rely on generous people like you. Please, will you give $29 or more now to support our heroes around the world at this urgent moment and into the future?**](https://links.e.uso.)
**[RUSH AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://links.e.uso.)**
---
**The USO is the only nonprofit organization that goes wherever our service members do** -- from communities devastated by hurricanes, wildfires and other disasters across the United States to conflict zones around the world.
Right now, our teams are actively working to assess the needs of service members in Florida -- including National Guard members deployed in response to this emergency and military families stationed in the affected communities. We're ready to do whatever it takes to support them, from providing water and basic hygiene items to making sure they have the ability to connect with their loved ones.
**Your support makes all that and more possible, so please:**[**Will you rush $29 or more now to help reach our $50,000 rapid-response goal by midnight so we can support all of our heroes, including those responding to this emergency?**](https://links.e.uso.)
**[RUSH AN EMERGENCY DONATION](https://links.e.uso.)**
---
We'll continue to keep you updated as this ongoing situation develops -- for now, thank you for helping the USO be there for service members and their families when they need us most.
--The USO
*Your contribution will be joined with the contributions of others, and used where it is needed most to strengthen the well-being of the people serving in America's military and their families.

Patriot,

It's simple.

We cannot fix Washington without independent, common sense leaders who bring
people together.

I'm running for Senate because Washington is broken, and I'm ready to get
right to work with bipartisan, common sense solutions to finally fix the mess.

But with my race in a deadlock, and Marylanders already beginning to cast
their votes, pulling off a victory will require all hands on deck.

Can I count on your support?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-oct-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241010_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

DONATE

Extreme partisanship and inaction have held us back for too long. Many
Washington politicians simply choose to argue with each other instead of
getting anything done for the people.

With your help, we can send a loud and clear message to all the politicians
in Washington that will be heard all across America this November.

Please consider chipping in your most generous contribution to my campaign
today. Anything you can give makes an important difference right now.

This is a grassroots movement, and we rely on people like you to fuel our
campaign.

Thank you,
Gov. Larry Hogan

A Personal Message from Governor Larry Hogan:

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241010_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this
race. And that’s why your support TODAY is so crucial.

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in
helping me continue building a strong campaign.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241010_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20241010_urgent-request-email-2_aafd_acs&amtposition=2>
Thank you,
Larry Hogan
