name: Greg Casar
subject: DACA is in court this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GREG CASAR FOR CONGRESS
body:
Hundreds of thousands of Dreamers are still at-risk
Peter,
Today, a federal court heard arguments on the fate of hundreds of thousands of Dreamers who were brought to the U.S. as children and shielded from deportation under the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program, created by President Obama.
**Thanks to the DACA program, Dreamers have been able to go to school, pursue their careers, pay taxes, buy homes, start families, and serve in our armed forces. They’ve contributed enormously to our economy and our communities — and for many, America is the only home they’ve ever known.**
But shamefully, Republican politicians, including right here in Texas, have tried to eliminate the program and put Dreamers at risk of deportation. As president, Trump tried to eliminate DACA in 2017. And today, the state of Texas is leading the charge to eliminate the program in court – despite Dreamers contributing BILLIONS to the Texas economy.
For more than a decade, Republicans in Congress have blocked the DREAM Act, legislation that would put Dreamers on a pathway to citizenship. Their refusal to act has left hundreds of thousands of Dreamers with a cloud of uncertainty that looms even larger today.
While Republicans in Congress claim they support legal immigration, they’ve continued to block any legislation and attack any program that puts immigrants on a pathway to citizenship or helps keep immigrant families together.
**Let me be clear: Immigration is good. Immigrants and Dreamers help strengthen America. They contribute to our economy and to our national heritage. We can build a more effective, humane immigration system by working together. That’s what I’ll keep fighting for in Congress with your help.**
In solidarity,

-Greg
****
Greg Casar
Congressman
Texas Congressional District 35

They’ve contributed enormously to our economy and our communities — and for many, America is the only home they’ve ever known. But shamefully, Republican politicians, including right here in Texas, have tried to eliminate the program and put Dreamers at risk of deportation. As president, Trump tried to eliminate DACA in 2017. And today, the state of Texas is leading the charge to eliminate the program in court – despite Dreamers contributing BILLIONS to the Texas economy. For more than a decade, Republicans in Congress have blocked the DREAM Act, legislation that would put Dreamers on a pathway to citizenship. Their refusal to act has left hundreds of thousands of Dreamers with a cloud of uncertainty that looms even larger today. While Republicans in Congress claim they support legal immigration, they’ve continued to block any legislation and attack any program that puts immigrants on a pathway to citizenship or helps keep immigrant families together. Let me be clear: Immigration is good. Immigrants and Dreamers help strengthen America. They contribute to our economy and to our national heritage. We can build a more effective, humane immigration system by working together. That’s what I’ll keep fighting for in Congress with your help. In solidarity, -Greg ** Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 ****=** | ****** ---|---

subject: We are legally required to report what we’ve raised after this last FEC deadline
body:
There’s too much at stake for us to come up short.
---
Our final FEC fundraising deadline of this election cycle will be here before we know it. After that, we’ll be legally required to report how much we’ve raised, and _everyone_ will be watching. **Here’s the truth:** With tight polling numbers in battleground states and early voting underway, reaching our fundraising goals matters now more than ever. This isn’t just about the DNC reporting a big number but about ensuring we have the resources to fund state parties and Democrats in must-win swing states and beyond. No one is better positioned to help elect Democrats from local offices to the Oval Office in this final sprint than us. We have doors to knock on, voters to talk to, and phone calls to make. We need to run ads in swing states and ramp up our voter protection efforts. **And we can’t do this without your help.** If everyone reading this email pitched in $3 today, we’d quickly reach our fundraising goals and have the resources we need to make an impact in this last stretch. But not everyone gives, which is why we’re hoping all Democrats who understand the stakes of this deadline and this moment will chip in today. Please: [**Can we count on you to contribute $3 directly to the Democratic National Committee? Your support will help us reach our goals before we go public with our fundraising numbers, and everything we raise between now and our final FEC deadline will go toward persuading and turning out voters.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20241010_1803_fr&refcode2=1803_22930333_ix3I9e&akid=1803%2E22930333%2Eix3I9e) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20241010_1803_fr&refcode2=1803_22930333_ix3I9e&akid=1803%2E22930333%2Eix3I9e)**

## [**Alina Habba Pressed the Panic Button Over Trump Losing This Ugly Court Fight**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=21dvt2qr2o12ika2gbtkc46xdndzuoo7qhf0lmmjxui97xdjt7glsl653q7s1hxs0rrvm0ar1pucycqlvrlk1gb0vmqoi2mux47e9e7cbra0967oljj7ymmm7fyab4nzxzrww8ppsiomsct5qn5kuzntitpiq7r1bk9fhf4c4rgkw0y1i141u5ls3zxgm17a2e1j1rvu1750nr9tqfbq6tvci80y6bzouoxyl55kxbu&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sl5wut&__onlt=h)

Trump legal spokeswoman Alina Habba knows trouble when she sees it.

| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven't read the book, you know the name. It's _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we're working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America 's greatest author.**

body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7860%2E5257348%2EAIF_0s ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,
Californians understand the devastating impacts of the climate crisis, and
our thoughts are with the people of Florida as Hurricane Milton viciously
strikes the Gulf Coast.

The people of FL-13 deserve better representation in this crisis. Democrat
Whitney Fox is running a competitive race against MAGA Rep. Anna Paulina
Luna, the member who authored the bogus censure resolution against me and
who voted to shut down the federal government — including FEMA — days
before Hurricane Helene’s impact last month. Now Luna is demanding the
FEMA funding she voted against.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em_whitneyfox.SVSKU3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241010_PM2_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7860%2E5257348%2EAIF_0s ]An article from the New Republic that says: Florida Republican Demands
Hurricane Aid She Tried to Block Republican Representative Anna Paulina
Luna demanded more FEMA funding for Florida, just weeks after she voted
against a bill that provided $20 billion for federal emergency funds.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em_whitneyfox.SVSKU3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241010_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=7860%2E5257348%2EAIF_0s ]Whitney Fox has paused her campaign fundraising and redirected her
staff to help community members access resources to weather this storm.
Can you chip in to help close the gap to fully fund her campaign plan,
flip FL-13 blue, and help Democrats take back the House? Split an urgent
$10
donation.

In the state of Florida — even in the hyperpartisan Trump era — most
elected officials in both parties have understood the need to work in a
bipartisan manner to coordinate state, local, and federal resources in a
crisis.

But rather than supporting her constituents with much-needed relief, Rep.
Luna is attacking Vice President Kamala Harris on the news.

But that’s unfortunately what we can expect from a MAGA House member who
announced her censure resolution against me on Steve Bannon’s podcast —
the disgraced white nationalist former Trump White House senior advisor,
editor of Breitbart, and current inmate in federal prison.

The good news is this: She is beatable.

Whitney Fox is polling neck-and-neck with Anna Paulina Luna — who, we
can’t forget, not only led the bogus censure resolution against me but
unsuccessfully attempted to have me expelled from Congress as well. (Not
to mention fined $16 million).

Derek, we
have the opportunity to not only defeat one of Trump’s closest allies in
Congress, but we can get one step closer to flipping control of the House
from red to blue.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2024_abs_em_whitneyfox.SVSKU3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20241010_PM2_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1006&akid=7860%2E5257348%2EAIF_0s ]If you can spare just
$10 to
split between our campaign and Whitney’s, it will help Whitney’s campaign
win this flippable seat, eliminate one of Trump’s biggest backers in
Congress, and secure a new Democratic majority. Please chip in.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split
donation to Whitney Fox and Adam Schiff will go through immediately:

body:
Help us have the last word
#
Peter,
You’ve probably read a lot from our campaign about reaching “undecided voters” before Election Day, but have you ever thought about who those people may be? What types of messages sway their votes?
Political scientists, psychologists, and other professionals have done deep dives and studies trying to understand the undecided voter. One thing is clear from their findings: The candidate that has the last word usually gets their vote.
**So how do we make sure Lucas’ message is the last one these voters hear?**
We flood the airwaves with positive ads about Lucas and his mission to take back this Senate seat for working families. We reach out directly to voters through phone calls, email, texting, canvassing, and we tell them about how Lucas will secure reproductive freedoms for all Missourians.
**Josh Hawley and his billionaire-funded Super PAC will do everything they can to stop us. But Lucas’ message is one that Missourians want to hear — regardless of who they’ve voted for before.**
We have to keep reaching these undecided voters if we want their votes.
**[So Peter, can we count on you to help us keep Lucas’ ads on TV by chipping in $10 today? Peter, as you read this, Ohioans are casting their ballots. It's exciting, but it's also a reminder that we're in the final stretch – and that we urgently need to work together to win. Here's why:

**[1] Ohio is now the ONLY toss-up Senate race** in the country according to _Sabato's Crystal Ball_ – meaning, if we lose, Democrats will lose control of the Senate.

**[2] Republicans have outspent us 3-to-1** to smear me on the airwaves with nasty and false attack ads and to prop up my MAGA opponent, Bernie Moreno.

name: Justice Democrats
subject: re: Hurricane Milton
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After the Southern U.S. was slammed by Hurricane Helene, which created
unprecedented flooding and destruction in places like Asheville, NC, a
second historic hurricane rapidly formed less than two weeks later.

Hurricane Milton grew from a tropical storm to a category 5 hurricane in
less than 24 hours, becoming one of the most powerful Atlantic Ocean
hurricanes ever recorded.Milton made landfall in Florida last evening,
bringing destructive storm surges, tornadoes, flooding, and extreme winds
to the Tampa Bay area and other communities, sadly killing at least four
people and leaving 3 million without power.

Thankfully, the storm was downgraded and moved offshore, with the FEMA
director noting that Florida dodged “the worst-case scenario.” But this is
yet another ‘storm of the century,’ which experts warn are becoming all
the more common due to climate change. Milton dropped 18 inches of rain on
St. Petersburg, a 1-in-1000 year rainfall event. Unusually warm ocean
water in the Gulf of Mexico contributed to the rapid development of
Milton’s speed and intensity, with wind gusts pushing 180 miles per hour
on Monday. NBC meteorologist John Morales almost broke down in tears when
describing how terrifyingly fast this hurricane developed.

This is becoming our new normal,
Peter, and unless our elected officials take
bold, decisive action on climate soon, there will be no turning back.

While we continue to push leaders in Congress to join Justice Democrats in
supporting climate action like the Green New Deal, let’s also come
together and help those in need in the aftermath of this natural disaster.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20241010-hurricane-milton.NpecPn&refcode=em20241010-36059&t=1002&akid=36059%2E1203867%2ENpIu7t ]If you can, split a contribution between World Central Kitchen,
Volunteer Florida’s Florida Disaster Fund, and Project HOPE to provide
relief to Florida communities impacted by Milton.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

I'm not a politician by trade, but I'm a patriot by heart. And that's why I'm writing to you today, with a sense of urgency and a call to action.

As a proud Navy Veteran, Navy Wife, Navy Mom, and Nurse Practitioner, I've dedicated my life to serving this great nation and protecting its people.

But I've had enough of the empty promises and failed leadership in Washington. That's why I took a stand and ran for office - to fight for the values and freedoms that we hold dear.

And I'm not just fighting for a seat in Congress, I'm fighting for the future of our country. The Democrats know it, and that's why they're pulling out all the stops to take me down.

I'm one of their top targets, and millions of dollars are being poured into defeating me. _**But I won't back down. **_
